content.json:
# 📊 Security Operations Workbook
> ⚠️ This workbook does not replace alert triage. Alerts and incidents should still be investigated for a deeper investigation.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.label: Hostname
parameters.description: Device name or part of it. Leave empty for all devices.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.label: User
parameters.description: UPN or name part. Leave empty for all users (Alert Dashboard).

parameters.name: UserPrincipalName
parameters.label: User UPN
parameters.description: Full UPN for User Investigation and user hunts.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.label: Analyst
parameters.description: Incident owner (Incident Dashboard). All shows every incident.
parameters.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Owner) by IncidentNumber
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
| extend OwnerName = iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName)
| distinct OwnerName
| sort by OwnerName asc

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let UserSearch = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserName}"));
let UserLocal = tostring(split(UserSearch, "@")[0]);
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ProductName has_any ("Defender", "Microsoft 365", "MDATP")
    or ProviderName has_any ("MDATP", "Microsoft 365 Defender", "Microsoft XDR")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend Ents = parse_json(Entities)
| mv-apply E = Ents on (
    extend T = tolower(tostring(E.Type))
    | summarize
        Hosts = make_set_if(coalesce(tostring(E.HostName), tostring(E.FQDN)), T == "host", 5),
        Accounts = make_set_if(iff(isnotempty(tostring(E.UPNSuffix)), strcat(tostring(E.Name), "@", tostring(E.UPNSuffix)), tostring(E.Name)), T == "account", 5),
        Files = make_set_if(strcat(tostring(E.Directory), "/", tostring(E.Name)), T == "file", 5),
        Commands = make_set_if(substring(tostring(E.CommandLine), 0, 200), T == "process" and isnotempty(tostring(E.CommandLine)), 3),
        Hashes = make_set_if(tostring(E.Value), T == "filehash" and tostring(E.Algorithm) =~ "SHA256", 5),
        IPs = make_set_if(tostring(E.Address), T == "ip", 5),
        Urls = make_set_if(tostring(E.Url), T == "url", 5)
)
| extend Device = iff(array_length(Hosts) > 0, strcat_array(Hosts, ", "), CompromisedEntity)
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or Device has TargetDevice or CompromisedEntity has TargetDevice
| where isempty(UserSearch)
    or tolower(strcat_array(Accounts, ",")) contains UserLocal
    or tolower(Entities) contains UserSearch
| extend SevOrder = case(AlertSeverity =~ "High", 1, AlertSeverity =~ "Medium", 2, AlertSeverity =~ "Low", 3, 4)
| extend ThreatFamily = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties).ThreatFamily)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Status,
    Severity = case(AlertSeverity =~ "High", "🔴 High", AlertSeverity =~ "Medium", "🟠 Medium",
                    AlertSeverity =~ "Low", "🟡 Low", "⚪ Informational"),
    Title = AlertName,
    Description = substring(Description, 0, 250),
    Device,
    Account = strcat_array(Accounts, ", "),
    Files = replace_string(strcat_array(Files, ", "), "//", "/"),
    Commands = strcat_array(Commands, " || "),
    IOCs = strcat_array(array_concat(Urls, IPs), ", "),
    SHA256 = strcat_array(Hashes, ", "),
    ThreatFamily,
    SystemAlertId,
    Category = Tactics,
    SevOrder
| sort by SevOrder asc, TimeGenerated desc
| project-away SevOrder
content.title: 🚨 Alerts
🥧 Detection by Severity
🎯 Detections by Tactic
⚙️ Processes On Device
📂 Alert Status

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let UserSearch = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserName}"));
let UserLocal = tostring(split(UserSearch, "@")[0]);
let A = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or CompromisedEntity has TargetDevice or Entities has TargetDevice
    | where isempty(UserSearch)
        or tolower(Entities) contains UserSearch
        or tolower(Entities) contains strcat('"name":"', UserLocal, '"')
        or tolower(CompromisedEntity) contains UserLocal;
A
| extend SevRank = case(AlertSeverity == "High", 4, AlertSeverity == "Medium", 3, AlertSeverity == "Low", 2, 1),
         Users = extract_all(@'"UserPrincipalName":"([^"]+)"', Entities)
| summarize Count = count(),
            SevRank = max(SevRank),
            Devices = dcount(CompromisedEntity),
            Users = make_set(Users, 10),
            Product = take_any(ProductName),
            Tactics = make_set(Tactics, 5),
            Status = make_set(Status, 3),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by AlertName
| sort by Count desc
| take 10
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 4, "High", SevRank == 3, "Medium", SevRank == 2, "Low", "Informational"),
         Users = strcat_array(Users, ", "),
         Tactics = strcat_array(Tactics, ", "),
         Status = strcat_array(Status, ", ")
| project AlertName, Count, Severity, Product, Tactics, Devices, Users, Status, FirstSeen, LastSeen
content.title: 🔟 Top 10 Alert Types
📈 Alerts Over Time by Severity

content.query:
let SlaHours = dynamic({"High": 4, "Medium": 24, "Low": 72, "Informational": 168});
let Inc = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *),
                FirstAck = minif(TimeGenerated, Status != "New" or isnotempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)))
             by IncidentNumber
    | extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
    | where "{Owner}" == "*" or iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName) == "{Owner}"
    | extend IsOpen = Status != "Closed",
             AgeHours = datetime_diff("minute", iff(Status == "Closed", ClosedTime, now()), CreatedTime) / 60.0,
             AckHours = datetime_diff("minute", FirstAck, CreatedTime) / 60.0;
Inc
| summarize Total = count(),
            Open = countif(IsOpen),
            Unassigned = countif(IsOpen and isempty(OwnerName)),
            OpenHigh = countif(IsOpen and Severity == "High"),
            Breached = countif(IsOpen and AgeHours > todouble(SlaHours[Severity])),
            Closed = countif(not(IsOpen)),
            MTTA = avgif(AckHours, AckHours >= 0),
            MTTR = avgif(AgeHours, not(IsOpen)),
            TP = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
            Classified = countif(isnotempty(Classification))
| extend Rows = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "🗂️ Total", "Value", tostring(Total)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "📂 Open", "Value", tostring(Open)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🙋 Unassigned", "Value", tostring(Unassigned)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🔴 Open High", "Value", tostring(OpenHigh)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "⏰ SLA Breached", "Value", tostring(Breached)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "✅ Closed", "Value", tostring(Closed)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "⏱️ MTTA", "Value", iff(isnan(MTTA) or isnull(MTTA), "-", strcat(round(MTTA, 1), " h"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🏁 MTTR", "Value", iff(isnan(MTTR) or isnull(MTTR), "-", strcat(round(MTTR, 1), " h"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🎯 True Positive Rate", "Value", iff(Classified == 0, "-", strcat(round(100.0 * TP / Classified, 0), "%"))))
| mv-expand Row = Rows
| project Metric = tostring(Row.Metric), Value = tostring(Row.Value)
content.title: 📊 Incident Summary

content.query:
let SlaHours = dynamic({"High": 4, "Medium": 24, "Low": 72, "Informational": 168});
let StaleHours = 24;
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status != "Closed"
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
| where "{Owner}" == "*" or iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName) == "{Owner}"
| extend AgeHours = round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), CreatedTime) / 60.0, 1),
         SinceUpdateHours = round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastModifiedTime) / 60.0, 1),
         Sla = todouble(SlaHours[Severity])
| extend Flags = strcat_array(array_concat(
    iff(AgeHours > Sla, dynamic(["⏰ SLA Breached"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(isempty(OwnerName), dynamic(["🙋 Unassigned"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(SinceUpdateHours > StaleHours, dynamic(["💤 Stale"]), dynamic([]))), " ")
| extend SevOrder = case(Severity == "High", 1, Severity == "Medium", 2, Severity == "Low", 3, 4)
| extend Breach = iff(AgeHours > Sla, 0, 1)
| sort by Breach asc, SevOrder asc, AgeHours desc
| project
    Incident = IncidentNumber,
    Title,
    Severity = case(Severity == "High", "🔴 High", Severity == "Medium", "🟠 Medium", Severity == "Low", "🟡 Low", "⚪ Informational"),
    Status,
    Owner = iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName),
    Flags,
    AgeHours,
    SinceUpdateHours,
    Alerts = toint(AdditionalData.alertsCount),
    Products = strcat_array(todynamic(AdditionalData.alertProductNames), ", "),
    Tactics = strcat_array(todynamic(AdditionalData.tactics), ", "),
    CreatedTime,
    IncidentUrl
content.title: 📋 Open Incident Queue

| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))

content.title: 📂 Incidents by Status

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status == "Closed"
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
| where "{Owner}" == "*" or iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName) == "{Owner}"
| extend Classification = case(Classification == "TruePositive", "🎯 True Positive",
                               Classification == "BenignPositive", "🟢 Benign Positive",
                               Classification == "FalsePositive", "⚪ False Positive",
                               "❔ Undetermined"),
         Reason = iff(isempty(ClassificationReason), "Not set", ClassificationReason)
| summarize Incidents = count() by Classification, Reason
| sort by Incidents desc
content.title: 🏷️ Closed by Classification

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
| where "{Owner}" == "*" or iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName) == "{Owner}"
| extend SevRank = case(Severity == "High", 4, Severity == "Medium", 3, Severity == "Low", 2, 1)
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            Open = countif(Status != "Closed"),
            TruePositive = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
            BenignOrFalse = countif(Classification in ("BenignPositive", "FalsePositive")),
            SevRank = max(SevRank),
            Products = take_any(strcat_array(todynamic(AdditionalData.alertProductNames), ", ")),
            AvgHoursToClose = round(avgif(datetime_diff("minute", ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, Status == "Closed"), 1),
            FirstSeen = min(CreatedTime),
            LastSeen = max(CreatedTime)
         by Title
| top 10 by Incidents desc
| extend NoiseRate = iff(TruePositive + BenignOrFalse == 0, "-", strcat(round(100.0 * BenignOrFalse / (TruePositive + BenignOrFalse), 0), "%")),
         Severity = case(SevRank == 4, "🔴 High", SevRank == 3, "🟠 Medium", SevRank == 2, "🟡 Low", "⚪ Informational")
| project Title, Incidents, Open, Severity, TruePositive, BenignOrFalse, NoiseRate, AvgHoursToClose, Products, FirstSeen, LastSeen
content.title: 🔁 Top 10 Recurring Incidents

content.query:
let Inc = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
    | extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
    | where "{Owner}" == "*" or iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName) == "{Owner}"
    | mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
    | project IncidentNumber, Status, Severity, AlertId;
let Alerts = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Entities) by SystemAlertId;
Inc
| join kind=inner Alerts on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| mv-apply E = parse_json(Entities) on (
    extend T = tolower(tostring(E.Type))
    | extend Entity = case(
        T == "host", tolower(coalesce(tostring(E.HostName), tostring(E.FQDN))),
        T == "account", tolower(iff(isnotempty(tostring(E.UPNSuffix)), strcat(tostring(E.Name), "@", tostring(E.UPNSuffix)), tostring(E.Name))),
        T == "ip", tostring(E.Address),
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Entity)
    | project Type = case(T == "host", "🖥️ Host", T == "account", "👤 Account", "🌐 IP"), Entity)
| summarize Incidents = dcount(IncidentNumber),
            OpenIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, Status != "Closed"),
            HighIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, Severity == "High"),
            IncidentNumbers = make_set(IncidentNumber, 10)
         by Type, Entity
| top 15 by Incidents desc
content.title: 🎯 Most Involved Entities

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(Owner.assignedTo), tostring(Owner.email), tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName))
| where "{Owner}" == "*" or iff(isempty(OwnerName), "Unassigned", OwnerName) == "{Owner}"
| summarize Incidents = count() by bin(CreatedTime, 1d), Severity
content.title: 📈 Incidents Over Time by Severity

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType == "AntivirusDetection"
| extend Fields = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| extend
    ThreatName = tostring(Fields.ThreatName),
    WasRemediated = tostring(Fields.WasRemediated),
    WasExecutingWhileDetected = tostring(Fields.WasExecutingWhileDetected),
    RemediationAction = tostring(Fields.RemediationAction)
| where isnotempty(ThreatName)
| extend
    NotRemediated = WasRemediated =~ "false" or RemediationAction has_any ("Allowed", "NotRemediated", "Failed"),
    WasRunning = WasExecutingWhileDetected =~ "true",
    IsHighImpactFamily = ThreatName has_any (
        "Ransom", "Backdoor", "Mimikatz", "Rootkit", "HackTool", "VirTool", "Exploit",
        "Cobalt", "Meterpreter", "Sliver", "Emotet", "Qakbot", "AsyncRAT",
        "RedLine", "Lumma", "Vidar", "Amadey"
    ),
    RanFromSuspiciousPath = FolderPath has_any (
        "\\Temp\\", "\\AppData\\", "\\Downloads\\", "\\Users\\Public\\",
        "\\ProgramData\\", "\\PerfLogs\\", "/tmp/", "/dev/shm/", "/var/tmp/"
    )
| extend RiskScore = toint(3 + iff(NotRemediated, 4, 0) + iff(WasRunning, 3, 0)
                             + iff(IsHighImpactFamily, 3, 0) + iff(RanFromSuspiciousPath, 1, 0))
| extend Severity = case(RiskScore >= 10, "🔴 Critical", RiskScore >= 7, "🟠 High", RiskScore >= 5, "🟡 Medium", "🟢 Low")
| extend Action = case(
    NotRemediated, "❌ Not Remediated",
    WasRemediated =~ "true", "✅ Remediated / Blocked",
    isnotempty(RemediationAction), RemediationAction,
    "❔ Unknown")
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Hits = count(),
    Files = make_set(FileName, 5),
    Paths = make_set(FolderPath, 5)
    by Severity, RiskScore, ThreatName, DeviceName, Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
       Action, InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256,
       WasRemediated, WasExecutingWhileDetected, RemediationAction,
       NotRemediated, WasRunning, IsHighImpactFamily, RanFromSuspiciousPath
| project
    TimeGenerated = FirstSeen, Severity, RiskScore, Hits, ThreatName,
    DeviceName, Account, Action,
    Files = strcat_array(Files, ", "), Paths = strcat_array(Paths, ", "),
    InitiatingProcess, SHA256,
    WasRemediated, WasExecutingWhileDetected, RemediationAction,
    NotRemediated, WasRunning, IsHighImpactFamily, RanFromSuspiciousPath,
    LastSeen
| sort by RiskScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
content.title: 🛡️ Antivirus Detections

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType == "AntivirusDetection"
| extend F = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| extend ThreatName = tostring(F.ThreatName),
         WasRemediated = tostring(F.WasRemediated),
         RemediationAction = tostring(F.RemediationAction)
| where isnotempty(ThreatName)
| extend
    NotRemediated = WasRemediated =~ "false" or RemediationAction has_any ("Allowed", "NotRemediated", "Failed"),
    WasRunning = tostring(F.WasExecutingWhileDetected) =~ "true",
    IsHighImpactFamily = ThreatName has_any (
        "Ransom", "Backdoor", "Mimikatz", "Rootkit", "HackTool", "VirTool", "Exploit",
        "Cobalt", "Meterpreter", "Sliver", "Emotet", "Qakbot", "AsyncRAT",
        "RedLine", "Lumma", "Vidar", "Amadey"),
    RanFromSuspiciousPath = FolderPath has_any (
        "\\Temp\\", "\\AppData\\", "\\Downloads\\", "\\Users\\Public\\",
        "\\ProgramData\\", "\\PerfLogs\\", "/tmp/", "/dev/shm/", "/var/tmp/")
| extend RiskScore = 3 + iff(NotRemediated, 4, 0) + iff(WasRunning, 3, 0)
                       + iff(IsHighImpactFamily, 3, 0) + iff(RanFromSuspiciousPath, 1, 0)
| extend Severity = case(RiskScore >= 10, "Critical", RiskScore >= 7, "High", RiskScore >= 5, "Medium", "Low")
| summarize Detections = count() by Severity
content.title: 🥧 AV Detections by Severity

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let AV = DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "AntivirusDetection"
    | extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
    | extend ThreatName = tostring(AF.ThreatName);
union
    (AV | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "🦠 Detections", Order = 1),
    (AV | summarize Value = dcount(DeviceName) | extend Metric = "💻 Devices", Order = 2),
    (AV | summarize Value = dcount(ThreatName) | extend Metric = "🧬 Unique Threats", Order = 3),
    (AV | summarize Value = countif(tostring(AF.WasRemediated) =~ "false") | extend Metric = "❌ Not Remediated", Order = 4),
    (AV | summarize Value = countif(tostring(AF.WasExecutingWhileDetected) =~ "true") | extend Metric = "⚠️ Ran Before Caught", Order = 5)
| sort by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: 🦠 AV Overview Tiles
📈 AV Detections Over Time

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType == "AntivirusDetection"
| extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| summarize Detections = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName),
            NotRemediated = countif(tostring(AF.WasRemediated) =~ "false"),
            RanBeforeCaught = countif(tostring(AF.WasExecutingWhileDetected) =~ "true"),
            SamplePath = take_any(FolderPath), SHA256 = take_any(SHA256),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by ThreatName = tostring(AF.ThreatName)
| top 10 by Detections desc
content.title: 🧬 Top Detected Threats

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let EdrProcesses = dynamic([
    "MsMpEng.exe", "MsSense.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "SenseCncProxy.exe",
    "CSFalconService.exe", "CSFalconContainer.exe",
    "SentinelAgent.exe", "SentinelServiceHost.exe", "SentinelStaticEngine.exe",
    "cb.exe", "RepMgr.exe", "RepUx.exe", "CylanceSvc.exe",
    "SophosHealth.exe", "SAVService.exe", "McShield.exe", "mfemms.exe",
    "ccSvcHst.exe", "SmcGui.exe", "xagt.exe", "TmCCSF.exe", "elastic-agent.exe"
]);
let EdrServices = dynamic([
    "WinDefend", "Sense", "WdNisSvc", "SecurityHealthService", "wscsvc",
    "CSFalconService", "SentinelAgent", "CbDefense", "CylanceSvc",
    "SAVService", "McAfeeFramework", "SepMasterService", "xagt"
]);
let VulnerableDrivers = dynamic([
    "rtcore64.sys", "rtkvhd64.sys", "gdrv.sys", "iqvw64e.sys", "dbutil_2_3.sys",
    "mhyprot2.sys", "procexp152.sys", "aswarpot.sys", "truesight.sys",
    "viragt64.sys", "kprocesshacker.sys", "gmer64.sys", "nvflash.sys",
    "elrawdsk.sys", "atillk64.sys", "speedfan.sys", "winio64.sys"
]);
let EdrKillerTools = dynamic([
    "aukill.exe", "terminator.exe", "edrkillshifter.exe", "edrsilencer.exe",
    "backstab.exe", "edrsandblast.exe", "gmer.exe", "processhacker.exe",
    "pchunter64.exe", "kdu.exe", "spyboy.exe", "zam64.sys"
]);
union isfuzzy=true
// 1. BYOVD - vulnerable signed driver loaded
(
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName has_any (VulnerableDrivers)
    | extend Technique = "🔴 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Load",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat("Driver: ", FileName, " | Path: ", FolderPath, " | By: ", InitiatingProcessFileName), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail
),
// 1b. BYOVD - vulnerable driver dropped
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName has_any (VulnerableDrivers)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Dropped",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat("Driver: ", FileName, " | Path: ", FolderPath, " | By: ", InitiatingProcessFileName), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail
),
// 2. EDR-killer tooling
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where tolower(FileName) in~ (EdrKillerTools)
        or (CmdArgs has_any (EdrKillerTools) and CmdArgs has_any (EdrProcesses))
    | extend Technique = "🔴 EDR-Killer Tool Execution",
             RiskScore = 10,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs, " | Path: ", FolderPath), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 3. EDR process termination
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe", "tskill.exe", "wmic.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "pskill.exe", "pskill64.exe")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (EdrProcesses)

    | extend Technique = "🔴 EDR Process Termination",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 4. EDR service stop / disable
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where FileName in~ ("sc.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "reg.exe")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (EdrServices)
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("stop", "delete", "disabled", "start= disabled", "Stop-Service", "Set-Service", "config", "Remove-Service")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 EDR Service Stop / Disable",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 5. Defender tampering
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (
        "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DisableBehaviorMonitoring",
        "DisableIOAVProtection", "DisableScriptScanning",
        "DisableArchiveScanning", "DisableBlockAtFirstSeen",
        "DisableAntiSpyware", "DisableAntiVirus",
        "TamperProtection", "MpEnablePus",
        "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath", "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionProcess",
        "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionExtension",
        "AmsiScanBuffer", "amsiInitFailed", "AmsiUtils"
    )
    | extend IsExclusion = CmdArgs has "ExclusionPath" or CmdArgs has "ExclusionProcess" or CmdArgs has "ExclusionExtension"
    | extend Technique = iff(IsExclusion, "🟠 Defender Exclusion Added", "🔴 Defender Protection Disabled"),
             RiskScore = iff(IsExclusion, 7, 9),
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 6. Safe Mode abuse
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("bcdedit", "safeboot", "bootstatuspolicy")
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("/set", "safeboot network", "safeboot minimal", "-set")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 Safe Mode Boot Configuration",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 7. Event log / telemetry tampering
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (
        "wevtutil cl", "wevtutil sl", "Clear-EventLog", "Remove-EventLog",
        "auditpol /clear", "auditpol /remove", "auditpol /set",
        "fsutil usn deletejournal", "EtwEventWrite", "PatchTraceLogging"
    )
    | extend Technique = "🔴 Event Log / ETW Tampering",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail

// 8. Native Defender tamper events
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in (
        "AntivirusDisabled", "AntivirusConfigurationChange",
        "TamperingAttempt", "SecurityLogCleared",
        "AntivirusScanCancelled", "AntivirusEmergencyUpdatesInstalled"
    )
    | extend Technique = "🔴 Native Defender Tamper Event",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(ActionType, " | ", tostring(AdditionalFields)), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail
)
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 9, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 7, "🟠 High",
    "🟡 Medium"
)
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    OccurrenceCount = count(),
    Details = make_set(Detail, 3)
    by Technique, Severity, RiskScore, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessName
| project
    FirstSeen,

    OccurrenceCount,
    Technique,
    DeviceName,
    AccountName,
    ProcessName,
    Details,
    RiskScore,
    LastSeen
| sort by RiskScore desc, OccurrenceCount desc

let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let MDE = DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
    | summarize by Name = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]));
let NotOnboarded = union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceInfo
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OnboardingStatus, OSPlatform) by DeviceName
        | where OnboardingStatus == "Can be onboarded"
        | project DeviceName, OSPlatform, LastSeen = TimeGenerated, Source = "Device discovery"),
    (Heartbeat
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where isempty(TargetDevice) or Computer has TargetDevice
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OSType) by Computer
        | project DeviceName = Computer, OSPlatform = OSType, LastSeen = TimeGenerated, Source = "Azure Monitor heartbeat")
    | extend Name = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]))
    | where Name !in (MDE)
    | summarize arg_max(LastSeen, DeviceName, OSPlatform), Sources = make_set(Source) by Name;
let TP = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where RegistryKey has @"Microsoft\Windows Defender\Features"
    | where RegistryValueName == "TamperProtection"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RegistryValueData) by DeviceId
    | project DeviceId, TPValue = RegistryValueData, TPChanged = TimeGenerated;
let Unhealthy = DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState, OSPlatform) by DeviceName, DeviceId
    | where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
    | where SensorHealthState !in~ ("Active", "")
    | join kind=leftouter TP on DeviceId
    | extend TamperProtection = case(
        TPValue == "5", "✅ On",
        TPValue in ("0", "4"), "⛔ Off",
        OSPlatform !startswith "Windows", "N/A",
        "❔ Unknown")
    | extend Severity = case(
        SensorHealthState has_any ("Inactive", "Misconfigured") or TamperProtection == "⛔ Off", "🔴 Critical",
        SensorHealthState has "ImpairedCommunication", "🟠 High",
        "🟡 Medium")
    | project LastSeen = TimeGenerated, Severity, DeviceName, OSPlatform, SensorHealthState,
              TamperProtection, TPChanged, OnboardingStatus, Source = "Defender", DeviceId;
union
    Unhealthy,
    (NotOnboarded
        | project LastSeen, Severity = "🔴 Critical", DeviceName, OSPlatform, SensorHealthState = "No sensor",
                  TamperProtection = "N/A", OnboardingStatus = "⚠️ Not Onboarded", Source = strcat_array(Sources, ", "))
| sort by Severity asc, LastSeen asc

        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OSType) by Computer
        | project DeviceName = Computer, OSPlatform = OSType, LastSeen = TimeGenerated, Source = "Azure Monitor heartbeat")
    | extend Name = tolower(tostring(split(DeviceName, ".")[0]))
    | where Name !in (MDE)
    | summarize arg_max(LastSeen, DeviceName, OSPlatform), Sources = make_set(Source) by Name;

    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState) by DeviceId
    | where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded";

union
    (print Value = Total | extend Metric = "🖥️ Total Devices", Order = 0),
    (H | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "💻 Onboarded", Order = 1),
    (H | summarize Value = countif(SensorHealthState == "Active") | extend Metric = "✅ Active", Order = 2),

    (print Value = Missing | extend Metric = "🚫 Not Onboarded", Order = 5),

// ============================================================

let TargetDevice = "{DeviceName}";

    "msedge.exe", "msedgewebview2.exe",
    "MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe", "IntuneManagementExtension.exe",

]);

    "Credential Access", "Ransomware Prep", "Backdoor", "Defense Evasion",
    "Account Manipulation", "Registry Modification", "Malicious PowerShell",

]);

    "MsMpEng.exe", "MsSense.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "SenseNdr.exe",
    "CSFalconService.exe", "CSFalconContainer.exe", "wdavdaemon", "mdatp",
    "falcon-sensor", "svchost.exe", "System", "csrss.exe", "wininit.exe",

    "www-data", "apache", "nginx", "postgres", "mysql", "nobody", "daemon",
    "guest", "defaultaccount", "wdagutilityaccount"
]);
union isfuzzy=true
// ============================================================
// TA0002 EXECUTION -- T1059 malicious PowerShell (download/encode/hidden)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "DownloadFile", "DownloadString", "DownloadData",
        "Invoke-Expression", "IEX", "iex(",
        "EncodedCommand", "-enc ", "-ec ",
        "FromBase64String",
        "Net.WebClient", "WebRequest", "Start-BitsTransfer",
        "Invoke-WebRequest", "curl ", "wget ")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "-WindowStyle Hidden"
            and ProcessCommandLine has "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "-NonInteractive"
            and ProcessCommandLine has "-NoProfile"
            and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http", "ftp", "\\\\"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "⚡ Malicious PowerShell", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("PS: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 250))
),
// ============================================================
// TA0003 PERSISTENCE -- T1547 autostart keys (registry-state source)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has_any (
        "CurrentVersion\\Run", "CurrentVersion\\RunOnce",
        "Winlogon\\Shell", "Winlogon\\Userinit", "Policies\\Explorer\\Run",
        "CurrentVersion\\RunServices", "CurrentVersion\\RunServicesOnce",
        "BootExecute", "AppInit_DLLs", "Image File Execution Options")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔧 Registry Persistence", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = "",
              SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Reg: ", RegistryValueName, " = ",
                             substring(RegistryValueData, 0, 200))
),
// ============================================================
// TA0003 PERSISTENCE -- T1053.005 / T1543 scheduled tasks & services
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "schtasks /create", "/sc onlogon", "/sc onstart",
        "/sc onstartup", "/ru system",
        "New-ScheduledTask", "Register-ScheduledTask",
        "sc create", "New-Service")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔧 Task/Service Persistence", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Task/Svc: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 250))
),
// ============================================================
// TA0003/TA0004 PERSISTENCE/PRIVESC -- T1098 account manipulation
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has "localgroup" and
             ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/add", "/delete"))
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "net user" and
            ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/add", "/delete"))
        or ProcessCommandLine has "/active:yes"
        or ProcessCommandLine has "/active:no"
        or ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "New-LocalUser", "Add-LocalGroupMember",
            "Set-LocalUser", "Enable-LocalUser", "Disable-LocalUser",
            "Remove-LocalGroupMember",
            "net localgroup administrators",
            "net localgroup \"remote desktop users\"")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "👤 Account Manipulation", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Account: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 250))
),
// ============================================================
// TA0005 DEFENSE EVASION -- T1112 persistence/RDP/AV registry mods (reg.exe)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName in~ ("reg.exe", "regedit.exe")
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("add", "delete", "import")
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "CurrentVersion\\Run", "CurrentVersion\\RunOnce",
            "Terminal Server", "fDenyTSConnections", "AllowTSConnections",
            "DisableAntiSpyware", "DisableAntiVirus",
            "Winlogon", "AppInit_DLLs", "Image File Execution Options",
            "SecurityProviders", "Lsa", "DisabledComponents")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📝 Registry Modification", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,

              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,

(
    DeviceProcessEvents

    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice

        "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DisableBehaviorMonitoring",

        "AmsiScanBuffer", "amsiInitFailed",

    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🥷 Defense Evasion", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Evasion: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 250))
),
// ============================================================
// TA0006 CREDENTIAL ACCESS -- T1003.001 LSASS dumping / cred tooling
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "Mimikatz", "sekurlsa", "logonpasswords", "lsadump",
        "procdump", "comsvcs.dll", "MiniDumpWriteDump", "nanodump",
        "lsass.dmp", "Out-Minidump", "pypykatz", "lsassy",
        "Invoke-Mimikatz", "DumpCreds")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs" and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "\\lsass")
        or (FileName =~ "procdump.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔑 Credential Access", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Cred: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 250))
),
// ============================================================
// TA0007 DISCOVERY -- T1087/T1069/T1558/T1082/T1016/T1018 recon
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend ReconCategory = case(
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "net group \"domain admins\"", "net group \"enterprise admins\"",
            "net group \"domain controllers\"", "net localgroup administrators",
            "net accounts /domain", "dsquery", "dsget", "adfind",
            "Get-ADUser", "Get-ADGroup", "Get-ADComputer", "Get-ADDomain",
            "Get-DomainUser", "Get-NetUser", "Get-NetGroup",
            "Get-DomainController", "Get-NetDomainController"),
            "🔴 AD Enumeration",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "SharpHound", "Invoke-BloodHound", "-CollectionMethod",
            "bloodhound", "azurehound", "Get-DomainTrust", "Get-ForestTrust"),
            "🔴 BloodHound/AD Mapping",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "setspn -q", "setspn -l", "Get-DomainSPNTicket",
            "Invoke-Kerberoast", "GetUserSPNs", "Rubeus kerberoast"),
            "🔴 Kerberos/SPN Recon",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "az account", "az ad", "aws sts get-caller-identity",
            "aws iam", "gcloud auth", "Get-AzureADUser", "Get-MgUser",
            "Connect-AzAccount", "Get-AzRoleAssignment",
            "kubectl get secrets"),
            "🔴 Cloud/Identity Recon",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "net view", "net share", "net session", "net use",
            "Get-NetShare", "Get-NetSession", "Find-DomainShare",
            "PsLoggedon", "quser", "qwinsta", "query session"),
            "🟠 Share/Session Discovery",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "net user", "net localgroup", "whoami /priv", "whoami /groups",
            "whoami /all", "Get-LocalUser", "Get-LocalGroupMember",
            "cmdkey /list", "wmic useraccount"),
            "🟠 Local Account/Priv Enum",
        (ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "Get-MpComputerStatus", "Get-MpPreference", "sc query windefend",
            "tasklist /svc", "fltmc", "driverquery")
            and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
                "defender", "crowdstrike", "sentinel",
                "cylance", "sophos", "mcafee", "falcon")),
            "🟠 Security Product Discovery",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "ipconfig", "arp -a", "arp /a", "route print", "netstat",
            "nltest /dclist", "nltest /domain_trusts", "nbtstat",
            "Resolve-DnsName", "ping -n"),
            "🟡 Network Discovery",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "systeminfo", "hostname", "wmic os", "wmic computersystem",
            "Get-ComputerInfo", "Get-WmiObject Win32_",
            "reg query", "wmic qfe", "wmic product"),
            "🟡 Host/System Enum",
        FileName in~ (
            "whoami.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe", "nltest.exe",
            "systeminfo.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "arp.exe", "route.exe",
            "quser.exe", "tasklist.exe", "netstat.exe", "wmic.exe",

    | where isnotempty(ReconCategory)
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔍 Discovery/Recon", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,

              Detail = strcat(ReconCategory, ": ", FileName, " ",

    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "UsbDriveMounted"
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📤 Exfil/Collection", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = "",
              SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
              Detail = strcat("USB mounted | ", substring(tostring(AdditionalFields), 0, 180))
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0003 PERSISTENCE -- T1547.001 Startup folder drops
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed", "FileModified")
    | where FolderPath contains "\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup"
    | where not(FileName endswith ".ini")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔧 Startup Persistence", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Startup drop: ", substring(FolderPath, 0, 200))
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0040 IMPACT -- T1486 mass file rename/modify by one process (encryption)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed", "FileModified")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (TrustedProcs)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("explorer.exe", "OneDrive.exe", "ms-teams.exe",
        "Teams.exe", "msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "SearchProtocolHost.exe", "TiWorker.exe",
        "msiexec.exe", "Dropbox.exe")
    | summarize Files = count(),
                NewExts = dcount(extract(@"\.([^.\\]+)$", 1, FileName)),
                LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
                Cmd = take_any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
                Acct = take_any(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
                Hash = take_any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
                by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, Bin = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
    | where Files >= 200
    | project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Signal = "💥 Ransomware Prep", DeviceName,
              Account = Acct,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = Cmd,
              ChildProcess = "",
              SHA256 = Hash,
              Detail = strcat("Mass file change: ", Files, " files / ", NewExts,
                             " extensions in 5 min")
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0040 IMPACT -- T1486 ransom notes dropped across many folders
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)(read_?me|decrypt|restore|recover|how_to|ransom).*\.(txt|hta|html?)$"
    | summarize Folders = dcount(FolderPath), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
                Note = take_any(FileName),
                Proc = take_any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                Cmd = take_any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
                Acct = take_any(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
                Hash = take_any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
                by DeviceName, Bin = bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where Folders >= 10
    | project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Signal = "💥 Ransomware Prep", DeviceName,
              Account = Acct,
              InitiatingProcess = Proc,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = Cmd,
              ChildProcess = Note,
              SHA256 = Hash,
              Detail = strcat("Ransom-note pattern '", Note, "' in ", Folders, " folders")
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0005 DEFENSE EVASION -- T1068 / T1562 BYOVD: drivers loaded from unusual paths
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "DriverLoad"
    | where not(FolderPath contains "\\System32\\drivers\\"
                or FolderPath contains "\\DriverStore\\"
                or FolderPath contains "\\WinSxS\\")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🧩 Suspicious Driver Load", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Driver: ", substring(FolderPath, 0, 200))
),
// ============================================================
// PRE-COMPROMISE -- risky files delivered from the internet or email (T1566, T1189)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed")
    | where isnotempty(FileOriginUrl) or isnotempty(FileOriginReferrerUrl) or FolderPath has @"\Content.Outlook\"
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(exe|dll|scr|msi|js|jse|vbs|vbe|wsf|hta|ps1|bat|cmd|lnk|iso|img|vhdx?|zip|rar|7z|one|xll|docm|xlsm|pptm)$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📥 Risky File Delivered", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("From: ", coalesce(FileOriginUrl, FileOriginReferrerUrl, "Outlook attachment"), " -> ", FolderPath)
),
// ============================================================
// PRE-COMPROMISE -- admin and database ports reached from the internet (T1133, T1190)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where LocalPort in (22, 23, 135, 139, 445, 1433, 3306, 3389, 5432, 5900, 5985, 5986)
    | summarize Conns = count(), Sources = dcount(RemoteIP), SampleIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 5),
                LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
                Proc = take_any(InitiatingProcessFileName), Cmd = take_any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
                by DeviceName, LocalPort, Bin = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Signal = "🚪 Inbound Exposure", DeviceName,
              Account = "",
              InitiatingProcess = Proc,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = Cmd,
              ChildProcess = "",
              SHA256 = "",
              Detail = strcat("Port ", LocalPort, " reached from ", Sources, " public IPs (", Conns,
                              " connections): ", strcat_array(SampleIPs, ", "))
),
// --- Schema pin keeps union column order and types stable ---
(
    datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, Signal:string, DeviceName:string,
              Account:string, InitiatingProcess:string,
              InitiatingProcessCmd:string, ChildProcess:string,
              SHA256:string, ThreatName:string, Action:string, Detail:string)[]
)
// ============================================================
// NOISE SUPPRESSION - hard signals bypass this entirely
// ============================================================
| extend IsHardSignal = Signal has_any (HardSignalKeywords)
| extend IsBenignParent =
    InitiatingProcess in~ (BenignParents)
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains
        "\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\Content\\DetectionScripts\\"
    or (InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-ExecutionPolicy AllSigned"
        and InitiatingProcessCmd contains "SessionState.LanguageMode")
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "--msedgewebview"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "hpatchmonTask"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "RunCommandExtension"
    or Account =~ "mdatp"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "runuser -u mdatp"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "/var/lib/dpkg/info/mdatp."
    or (InitiatingProcess =~ "svchost.exe"
        and (InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-s DPS"
             or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-s SysMain"
             or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-s DiagTrack"))
| where IsHardSignal or Signal has "Risky File Delivered" or not(IsBenignParent)
// ============================================================
// RISK SCORING - base weight per signal type + situational modifiers
// ============================================================
| extend BaseScore = case(
    Signal contains "Alert (High)", 8,
    Signal contains "Alert (Medium)", 6,
    Signal contains "Alert (Low)", 4,
    Signal contains "Alert (Info)", 3,
    Signal has "Initial Access", 8,
    Signal has "Inbound Exposure", 5,
    Signal has "Risky File Delivered", 4,
    Signal has "LOLBin Execution", 7,
    Signal has "Suspicious Driver", 7,
    Signal has "Startup Persistence", 6,
    Signal has "Privilege Escalation", 7,
    Signal has "Download & Execute", 7,
    Signal has "Cryptominer", 7,
    Signal has "Exfil", 6,
    Signal has "Offensive Tool", 5,
    Signal has "Logon After Failures", 8,
    Signal has "External Remote Logon", 7,
    Signal has "Brute Force", 6,
    Signal has "Service Account Logon", 6,
    Signal has "Process Injection", 6,
    Signal has "New Listener", 6,
    Signal has "Suspicious Port", 6,
    Signal has "Shell/Temp Egress", 6,
    Signal has "Network Scan", 6,
    Signal has "Credential Access", 9,
    Signal has "Ransomware Prep", 9,
    Signal has "Backdoor", 9,
    Signal has "Defense Evasion", 7,
    Signal has "Registry Modification", 7,
    Signal has "Lateral Movement", 7,
    Signal has "Tunneling Tool", 7,
    Signal has "Registry Persistence", 6,
    Signal has "Task/Service Persistence", 6,
    Signal has "Account Manipulation", 6,
    Signal has "Malicious PowerShell", 6,
    Signal has "LOLBin Network Egress", 6,
    Signal has "Defender Detection" and Detail startswith "AntivirusReport", 4,
    Signal has "Defender Detection", 6,
    Signal has "Unauthorized Remote Tool", 5,
    Signal has "Discovery/Recon", 4,
    3
)
| extend DiscoveryBoost = case(
    Signal has "Discovery/Recon" and Detail has "🔴", 3,
    Signal has "Discovery/Recon" and Detail has "🟠", 2,
    0
)
| extend RiskScore = min_of(BaseScore + DiscoveryBoost + iff(IsHardSignal, 2, 0), 10)
| extend Phase = case(
    Signal startswith "🚨 Alert", "🚨 Alert",
    Signal matches regex "Brute Force|Risky File Delivered|Inbound Exposure"
        or (Signal has "Defender Detection" and Action matches regex "(?i)block|quarantin|remov|prevent|clean"), "1️⃣ Pre-Compromise",
    Signal matches regex "Initial Access|Download & Execute|Malicious PowerShell|LOLBin Execution|Logon After Failures|External Remote Logon", "2️⃣ Initial Access",
    "3️⃣ Post-Compromise")
| extend Severity = case(RiskScore >= 9, "🔴 Critical",
                         RiskScore >= 7, "🟠 High",
                         RiskScore >= 5, "🟡 Medium", "⚪ Low")
// ============================================================
// IOC EXTRACTION - IPs and domains pulled from the full detail and parent
// command line (before truncation). Loopback and Azure platform IPs dropped.
// ============================================================
| extend IocText = strcat(Detail, " ", InitiatingProcessCmd)
| extend Cands = array_concat(
    extract_all(@"(\d\d?\d?\.\d\d?\d?\.\d\d?\d?\.\d\d?\d?)", IocText),
    extract_all(@"(?i)(?:https?|ftp)://([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*)", IocText),
    extract_all(@"(?i)->\s([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*)", IocText))
| mv-apply Ioc = Cands to typeof(string) on (
    where isnotempty(Ioc)
    | where not(Ioc startswith "127." or Ioc in ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255",
                                                 "169.254.169.254", "168.63.129.16"))
    | where isnotnull(parse_ipv4(Ioc)) or Ioc matches regex @"(?i)[a-z]"
    | summarize IOCs = make_set(Ioc, 10)
)
| extend IOCs = strcat_array(IOCs, ", ")
| project-away IocText, Cands
| extend ThreatName = coalesce(ThreatName, ""), Action = coalesce(Action, "")
| extend InitiatingProcessCmd = substring(InitiatingProcessCmd, 0, 120)
| extend Detail = substring(Detail, 0, 150)
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Hits = count()
    by Severity, RiskScore, Phase, Signal, ThreatName, Action, DeviceName, Account, Detail, IOCs,
       InitiatingProcess, InitiatingProcessCmd, ChildProcess, SHA256,
       TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Severity, RiskScore, Phase, Hits, Signal, DeviceName, Account,
          Detail, IOCs, InitiatingProcess, InitiatingProcessCmd, ChildProcess, SHA256, ThreatName, Action
| sort by RiskScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
content.title: 🧭 Device Investigation Timeline

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let Net = DeviceNetworkInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isnotempty(TargetDevice) and DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId, NetworkAdapterName
    | mv-expand IP = IPAddresses
    | extend IPAddr = tostring(IP.IPAddress)
    | where isnotempty(IPAddr) and not(IPAddr startswith "127." or IPAddr startswith "fe80" or IPAddr == "::1")
    | summarize PrivateIPs = make_set(IPAddr, 5), MACs = make_set_if(MacAddress, isnotempty(MacAddress), 3) by DeviceId;
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(TargetDevice) and DeviceName has TargetDevice
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| lookup kind=leftouter Net on DeviceId
| extend Tags = strcat_array(set_union(todynamic(column_ifexists("DeviceManualTags", "[]")),
                                       todynamic(column_ifexists("DeviceDynamicTags", "[]"))), ", ")
| extend Users = strcat_array(extract_all(@'"UserName":"([^"]+)"', tostring(LoggedOnUsers)), ", ")
| extend Rows = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Field", "Device", "Value", DeviceName),
    bag_pack("Field", "OS", "Value", strcat(OSPlatform, " ", column_ifexists("OSDistribution", ""), " ", OSVersion)),
    bag_pack("Field", "LastSeen", "Value", format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")),
    bag_pack("Field", "PrivateIP", "Value", strcat_array(PrivateIPs, ", ")),
    bag_pack("Field", "MAC", "Value", strcat_array(MACs, ", ")),
    bag_pack("Field", "PublicIP", "Value", PublicIP),
    bag_pack("Field", "InternetFacing", "Value", iff(isnull(column_ifexists("IsInternetFacing", bool(null))), "Unknown", tostring(column_ifexists("IsInternetFacing", bool(null))))),
    bag_pack("Field", "DeviceGroup", "Value", MachineGroup),
    bag_pack("Field", "Tags", "Value", Tags),
    bag_pack("Field", "AssetValue", "Value", tostring(column_ifexists("AssetValue", ""))),
    bag_pack("Field", "ExposureLevel", "Value", tostring(column_ifexists("ExposureLevel", ""))),
    bag_pack("Field", "Onboarding", "Value", OnboardingStatus),
    bag_pack("Field", "SensorHealth", "Value", SensorHealthState),
    bag_pack("Field", "JoinType", "Value", tostring(column_ifexists("JoinType", ""))),
    bag_pack("Field", "LoggedOnUsers", "Value", Users))
| mv-expand Row = Rows
| project Field = tostring(Row.Field), Value = tostring(Row.Value)

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let PlatformIPs = dynamic(["168.63.129.16", "169.254.169.254"]);   // Azure host and metadata endpoints
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(TargetDevice) and DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "ConnectionRequest", "ConnectionAttempt")   // Linux logs outbound as ConnectionRequest
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" or isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteIP !in (PlatformIPs)
| extend IOC = coalesce(extract(@"^(?:[a-z]+://)?([^/:]+)", 1, tolower(RemoteUrl)), RemoteIP)
| top-nested 9 of IOC with others = "Other" by Connections = count()
| sort by Connections desc
