content.query:
// ============================================================
// USER INVESTIGATION - Workbook (Parameterized, Risk-Scored, Phase-Tagged)
// Parameters: {UserPrincipalName} (empty = all users), {TimeRange}
// ============================================================
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
let UserLocal  = tostring(split(TargetUser, "@")[0]);
let UserDomain = tostring(split(TargetUser, "@")[1]);
let LegacyClients = dynamic([
    "Exchange ActiveSync", "IMAP4", "POP3", "Authenticated SMTP", "Other clients",
    "Exchange Web Services", "AutoDiscover", "Offline Address Book",
    "Outlook Anywhere (RPC over HTTP)", "Exchange Online PowerShell"
]);
let PrivRoles = dynamic([
    "Global Administrator", "Privileged Role Administrator", "Privileged Authentication Administrator",
    "Exchange Administrator", "Security Administrator", "Application Administrator",
    "Cloud Application Administrator", "User Administrator", "Authentication Administrator",
    "SharePoint Administrator", "Conditional Access Administrator", "Intune Administrator"
]);
let RiskyScopes = dynamic([
    "Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.Send", "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite", "Files.ReadWrite.All",
    "Files.Read.All", "Sites.ReadWrite.All", "full_access_as_user", "EWS.AccessAsUser.All",
    "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Contacts.Read"
]);
let HighRiskDetections = dynamic([
    "anomalousToken", "tokenIssuerAnomaly", "attackerinTheMiddle", "maliciousIPAddress",
    "leakedCredentials", "passwordSpray", "mcasSuspiciousInboxManipulationRules",
    "investigationsThreatIntelligence", "suspiciousAPITraffic", "mcasImpossibleTravel"
]);
// ---------- Shared sources ----------
let Sign = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
             Loc = strcat(tostring(LocationDetails.city), ", ", tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)),
             Lat = todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.latitude),
             Lon = todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.longitude),
             Dev = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName),
             OSBrowser = strcat(tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem), " | ", tostring(split(tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), " ")[0]));
let OkSign = Sign | where ResultType == "0";
let Baseline = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. {TimeRange:start})
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | summarize BaseCountries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 200),
                BaseOSBrowser = make_set(strcat(tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem), " | ", tostring(split(tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), " ")[0])), 200)
        by UserPrincipalName;
let Audit = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend Target  = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)),
             Actor   = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))),
             ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or Target == TargetUser or Actor == TargetUser;
let Office = OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend P = strcat(tostring(Parameters), " ", tostring(column_ifexists("OperationProperties", ""))),
             CleanIP = coalesce(extract(@"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, ClientIP), ClientIP)
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserId) == TargetUser or P has TargetUser;
let TI = union isfuzzy=true
    (ThreatIntelligenceIndicator | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
        | summarize TIDesc = take_any(strcat(ThreatType, " ", Description)) by IP = NetworkIP),
    (ThreatIntelIndicators | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where ObservableKey has "ipv4"
        | summarize TIDesc = take_any(tostring(Data.description)) by IP = ObservableValue)
    | summarize TIDesc = take_any(TIDesc) by IP;
// ============================================================
union isfuzzy=true
// ---------- 🚨 Risky Sign-in ----------
(Sign
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium", "high") or RiskState == "atRisk"
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🚨 Risky Sign-in",
        RiskScore = toint(iff(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "high", 9, 7) - iff(ResultType == "0", 0, 2)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = Dev, App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat("Risk: ", RiskLevelDuringSignIn, " | State: ", RiskState, " | Events: ", tostring(RiskEventTypes_V2),
                        " | Result: ", iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", ResultDescription)),
        UserAgent, EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🛡️ Identity Protection Detection ----------
(AADUserRiskEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
    | extend L = parse_json(tostring(Location))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🛡️ Identity Protection Detection",
        RiskScore = toint(case(RiskEventType in (HighRiskDetections), 9, RiskLevel == "high", 8, RiskLevel == "medium", 6, 4)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress = IpAddress,
        Location = strcat(tostring(L.city), ", ", tostring(L.countryOrRegion)), DeviceName = "", App = Source,
        Detail = strcat(RiskEventType, " | Level: ", RiskLevel, " | State: ", RiskState, " | ", DetectionTimingType),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🔑 Brute Force / Spray ----------
(Sign
    | where ResultType in ("50126", "50053", "50034", "50056")
    | summarize Failures = count(), FirstFail = min(TimeGenerated), Codes = make_set(ResultType, 10)
        by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Loc, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where Failures >= 5
    | join kind=leftouter (OkSign | summarize SuccessTime = min(TimeGenerated), SuccessApp = take_any(AppDisplayName) by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress)
        on UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
    | extend Succeeded = isnotempty(SuccessTime) and SuccessTime >= FirstFail
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔑 Brute Force / Spray", RiskScore = toint(iff(Succeeded, 9, 6)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = "", App = iff(Succeeded, SuccessApp, ""),
        Detail = strcat(Failures, " failed logons (", strcat_array(Codes, ","), ")",
                        iff(Succeeded, strcat(" -> SUCCESS from same IP at ", format_datetime(SuccessTime, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")), "")),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Failures)),
// ---------- 📲 MFA Fatigue ----------
(Sign
    | where ResultType == "500121"
    | summarize Denied = count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Loc, AppDisplayName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where Denied >= 3
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📲 MFA Fatigue", RiskScore = toint(iff(Denied >= 10, 8, 7)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = "", App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat(Denied, " MFA challenges failed/denied in 1h"), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Denied)),
// ---------- ✈️ Impossible Travel ----------
(OkSign
    | where isnotempty(Lat) and isnotempty(Lon)
    | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Loc, Lat, Lon, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, Dev
    | sort by UserPrincipalName asc, TimeGenerated asc
    | extend PUser = prev(UserPrincipalName), PTime = prev(TimeGenerated), PLat = prev(Lat), PLon = prev(Lon), PIP = prev(IPAddress), PLoc = prev(Loc)
    | where PUser == UserPrincipalName and PIP != IPAddress
    | extend Km = geo_distance_2points(PLon, PLat, Lon, Lat) / 1000.0,
             Mins = datetime_diff("minute", TimeGenerated, PTime)
    | extend Kmh = Km / max_of(todouble(Mins) / 60.0, 0.05)
    | where Km > 500 and Kmh > 900
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "✈️ Impossible Travel", RiskScore = toint(8),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = Dev, App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat(PLoc, " (", PIP, ") -> ", Loc, " (", IPAddress, ") | ", round(Km), " km in ", Mins, " min"),
        UserAgent, EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🌍 New Country Sign-in (vs 30d baseline) ----------
(OkSign
    | join kind=inner Baseline on UserPrincipalName
    | where isnotempty(Country) and not(set_has_element(BaseCountries, Country))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🌍 New Country Sign-in", RiskScore = toint(7),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = Dev, App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat("First sign-in from ", Country, " in 30 days | Known: ", strcat_array(BaseCountries, ", ")),
        UserAgent, EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 💻 New OS / Browser (vs 30d baseline) ----------
(OkSign
    | join kind=inner Baseline on UserPrincipalName
    | where OSBrowser != " | " and not(set_has_element(BaseOSBrowser, OSBrowser))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "💻 New OS / Browser", RiskScore = toint(4),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = Dev, App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat("New client: ", OSBrowser), UserAgent, EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🕰️ Legacy Auth ----------
(Sign
    | where ClientAppUsed in (LegacyClients)
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🕰️ Legacy Auth", RiskScore = toint(iff(ResultType == "0", 6, 3)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = Dev, App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat("Client: ", ClientAppUsed, " | Result: ", iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", ResultDescription)),
        UserAgent, EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- ☠️ Sign-in from TI IP ----------
(Sign
    | join kind=inner TI on $left.IPAddress == $right.IP
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "☠️ Sign-in from Malicious IP", RiskScore = toint(iff(ResultType == "0", 9, 7)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location = Loc, DeviceName = Dev, App = AppDisplayName,
        Detail = strcat("TI: ", TIDesc, " | Result: ", iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", ResultDescription)),
        UserAgent, EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 📱 MFA / Auth Method Change ----------
(Audit
    | where OperationName has_any ("security info", "authentication method", "StrongAuthentication")
        or (OperationName == "Update user" and tostring(TargetResources) has "StrongAuthentication")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📱 MFA / Auth Method Change",
        RiskScore = toint(iff(OperationName has_any ("deleted", "delete", "removed"), 8, 7)),
        Account = coalesce(Target, Actor), IPAddress = ActorIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = LoggedByService,
        Detail = strcat(OperationName, " | By: ", Actor, " | Result: ", Result), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🔐 Password Reset / Change ----------
(Audit
    | where OperationName has "password" and OperationName !has "security info"
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔐 Password Reset / Change",
        RiskScore = toint(iff(isnotempty(Target) and Actor != Target, 6, 4)),
        Account = coalesce(Target, Actor), IPAddress = ActorIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = LoggedByService,
        Detail = strcat(OperationName, " | By: ", Actor, " | Result: ", Result), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 👑 Role Assignment ----------
(Audit
    | where OperationName has "member to role"
    | mv-apply mp = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties on (
        summarize Role = take_anyif(trim(@'"', tostring(mp.newValue)), tostring(mp.displayName) == "Role.DisplayName"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "👑 Role Assignment", RiskScore = toint(iff(Role in (PrivRoles), 9, 7)),
        Account = Target, IPAddress = ActorIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = LoggedByService,
        Detail = strcat(OperationName, " | Role: ", Role, " | By: ", Actor), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🔓 OAuth Consent ----------
(Audit
    | where OperationName in ("Consent to application", "Add delegated permission grant", "Add app role assignment grant to user")
    | mv-apply mp = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties on (
        summarize Perms = take_anyif(tostring(mp.newValue), tostring(mp.displayName) in ("ConsentAction.Permissions", "DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope")),
                  IsAdmin = take_anyif(tostring(mp.newValue), tostring(mp.displayName) == "ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔓 OAuth Consent", RiskScore = toint(iff(Perms has_any (RiskyScopes), 9, 7)),
        Account = Actor, IPAddress = ActorIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
        Detail = strcat(OperationName, " | AdminConsent: ", IsAdmin, " | Scopes: ", substring(Perms, 0, 300)), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🧩 App Credential / Owner Added ----------
(Audit
    | where OperationName has_any ("Add service principal credentials", "Certificates and secrets management", "Add owner to application", "Add owner to service principal")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🧩 App Credential / Owner Added", RiskScore = toint(8),
        Account = Actor, IPAddress = ActorIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
        Detail = strcat(OperationName, " | Target: ", tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 📧 Inbox Rule / Forwarding ----------
(Office
    | where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Enable-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules", "Set-Mailbox")
    | where Operation !~ "Set-Mailbox" or P has_any ("ForwardingSmtpAddress", "ForwardingAddress", "DeliverToMailboxAndForward")
    | extend Fwd = P has_any ("ForwardTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "ForwardingSmtpAddress", "ForwardingAddress"),
             Del = P has_any ("DeleteMessage", "SoftDeleteMessage"),
             Hide = P has_any ("RSS", "Conversation History", "Archive", "Junk"),
             MarkRead = P has "MarkAsRead"
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📧 Inbox Rule / Forwarding",
        RiskScore = toint(min_of(10, 5 + iff(Fwd, 3, 0) + iff(Del, 2, 0) + iff(Hide, 2, 0))),
        Account = UserId, IPAddress = CleanIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = "Exchange",
        Detail = strcat(Operation, " | ", iff(Fwd, "FORWARD ", ""), iff(Del, "DELETE ", ""), iff(Hide, "HIDE-FOLDER ", ""),
                        iff(MarkRead, "MARK-READ ", ""), "| ", substring(P, 0, 300)),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 👥 Mailbox Delegation / SendAs ----------
(Office
    | where Operation in~ ("Add-MailboxPermission", "Add-RecipientPermission", "Add-MailboxFolderPermission", "Set-MailboxFolderPermission", "Add-ADPermission")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "👥 Mailbox Delegation / SendAs",
        RiskScore = toint(iff(P has_any ("FullAccess", "SendAs"), 7, 6)),
        Account = UserId, IPAddress = CleanIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = "Exchange",
        Detail = strcat(Operation, " | ", substring(P, 0, 300)), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 📦 Mailbox Export / Content Search ----------
(Office
    | where Operation in~ ("New-MailboxExportRequest", "New-ComplianceSearch", "Start-ComplianceSearch", "New-ComplianceSearchAction", "New-MailboxSearch", "Search-Mailbox")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📦 Mailbox Export / Search", RiskScore = toint(8),
        Account = UserId, IPAddress = CleanIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = "Exchange",
        Detail = strcat(Operation, " | ", substring(P, 0, 300)), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🗑️ Mass Mail Delete ----------
(Office
    | where Operation in ("SoftDelete", "HardDelete", "MoveToDeletedItems")
    | summarize Cnt = count(), Ops = make_set(Operation, 3) by UserId, CleanIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where Cnt >= 50
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🗑️ Mass Mail Delete", RiskScore = toint(iff(set_has_element(Ops, "HardDelete"), 7, 6)),
        Account = UserId, IPAddress = CleanIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = "Exchange",
        Detail = strcat(Cnt, " delete operations in 1h (", strcat_array(Ops, ","), ")"), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Cnt)),
// ---------- ☁️ Mass SharePoint / OneDrive Download ----------
(Office
    | where Operation in ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull")
    | summarize Files = dcount(OfficeObjectId), Cnt = count(), Sample = make_set(SourceFileName, 5) by UserId, CleanIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where Files >= 50
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "☁️ Mass Cloud Download", RiskScore = toint(iff(Files >= 200, 8, 6)),
        Account = UserId, IPAddress = CleanIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = "SharePoint/OneDrive",
        Detail = strcat(Files, " files in 1h | e.g. ", strcat_array(Sample, ", ")), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Cnt)),
// ---------- 🔗 External / Anonymous Sharing ----------
(Office
    | where Operation in ("AnonymousLinkCreated", "SharingInvitationCreated", "SecureLinkCreated", "AddedToSecureLink")
    | extend TType = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetUserOrGroupType", "")), TName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetUserOrGroupName", ""))
    | where Operation == "AnonymousLinkCreated" or TType =~ "Guest" or TName has "#ext#"
    | summarize Cnt = count(), Sample = make_set(SourceFileName, 5), To = make_set(TName, 5) by UserId, CleanIP, Operation, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔗 External / Anonymous Sharing", RiskScore = toint(iff(Operation == "AnonymousLinkCreated", 6, 5)),
        Account = UserId, IPAddress = CleanIP, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = "SharePoint/OneDrive",
        Detail = strcat(Operation, " x", Cnt, " | Files: ", strcat_array(Sample, ", "), " | To: ", strcat_array(To, ", ")),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Cnt)),
// ---------- 🖥️ Device Logons by User ----------
(DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isnotempty(UserLocal) and tolower(AccountName) == UserLocal
    | summarize Success = countif(ActionType == "LogonSuccess"), Fail = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed")
        by DeviceName, LogonType, RemoteIP, RemoteIPType, AccountDomain, AccountName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | extend RiskScore = toint(case(RemoteIPType == "Public" and Success > 0, 7, Fail >= 10, 6, LogonType == "RemoteInteractive", 4, 2))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🖥️ Device Logon", RiskScore,
        Account = strcat(AccountDomain, "\\", AccountName), IPAddress = RemoteIP, Location = RemoteIPType, DeviceName,
        App = LogonType, Detail = strcat(LogonType, " | Success: ", Success, " | Failed: ", Fail),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Success + Fail)),
// ---------- 🎣 Phishing Click (root cause, includes 7 days before the range) ----------
(UrlClickEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (datetime_add("day", -7, {TimeRange:start}) .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(AccountUpn) == TargetUser
    | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) or IsClickedThrough == true or ActionType has "Blocked"
    | lookup kind=leftouter (EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
        | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(RecipientEmailAddress) == TargetUser
        | summarize SenderFromAddress = take_any(SenderFromAddress), Subject = take_any(Subject) by NetworkMessageId)
        on NetworkMessageId
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🎣 Phishing Click",
        RiskScore = toint(case(IsClickedThrough == true, 9, ActionType == "ClickAllowed" and isnotempty(ThreatTypes), 9, 6)),
        Account = AccountUpn, IPAddress, Location = "", DeviceName = "", App = Workload,
        Detail = strcat(ActionType, iff(IsClickedThrough == true, " (clicked through warning)", ""), " | ", Url,
                        iff(isnotempty(ThreatTypes), strcat(" | Threats: ", ThreatTypes), ""),
                        iff(isnotempty(SenderFromAddress), strcat(" | From: ", SenderFromAddress, " | ", Subject), "")),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1)),
// ---------- 🍪 Token Replay (one session, many IPs or countries) ----------
(union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | extend Loc = LocationDetails),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | extend Loc = todynamic(LocationDetails))
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | extend Sid = tostring(column_ifexists("SessionId", "")), Country = tostring(Loc.countryOrRegion)
    | where isnotempty(Sid)
    | summarize IPs = dcount(IPAddress), Countries = dcount(Country), IPList = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
                CountryList = make_set(Country, 5), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5), First = min(TimeGenerated), Cnt = count()
        by UserPrincipalName, Sid
    | where Countries >= 2 or IPs >= 4
    | project TimeGenerated = First, Signal = "🍪 Token Replay", RiskScore = toint(iff(Countries >= 2, 9, 6)),
        Account = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress = tostring(IPList[0]), Location = strcat_array(CountryList, ", "),
        DeviceName = "", App = strcat_array(Apps, ", "),
        Detail = strcat("Session ", Sid, " used from ", IPs, " IPs in ", Countries, " countries: ", strcat_array(IPList, ", ")),
        UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(Cnt)),
// ---------- 🚩 Security Alerts for User ----------
(SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(Entities) has TargetUser or tolower(Entities) contains strcat('"name":"', UserLocal, '"')
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🚩 Security Alert",
        RiskScore = toint(case(AlertSeverity == "High", 9, AlertSeverity == "Medium", 7, AlertSeverity == "Low", 5, 3)),
        Account = iff(isempty(TargetUser), CompromisedEntity, TargetUser),
        IPAddress = extract(@'"Address":"([^"]+)"', 1, Entities), Location = "",
        DeviceName = extract(@'"HostName":"([^"]+)"', 1, Entities), App = ProductName,
        Detail = strcat(AlertName, " | ", Status, " | ", substring(Description, 0, 200)), UserAgent = "", EventCount = tolong(1))
// ============================================================
| summarize Hits = sum(EventCount)
    by TimeGenerated = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Signal, RiskScore, Account, IPAddress, Location, DeviceName, App, Detail, UserAgent
| extend Severity = case(RiskScore >= 9, "Critical", RiskScore >= 7, "High", RiskScore >= 5, "Medium", RiskScore >= 3, "Low", "Informational")
| extend Phase = case(
    Signal startswith "🚩", "🚨 Alert",
    Signal has "MFA Fatigue"
        or (Signal has "Brute Force" and RiskScore < 9)
        or (Signal has "Phishing Click" and RiskScore < 9), "1️⃣ Pre-Compromise",
    Signal matches regex "Phishing Click|Brute Force|Risky Sign-in|Identity Protection|Impossible Travel|New Country|New OS|Legacy Auth|Malicious IP|Token Replay", "2️⃣ Initial Access",
    "3️⃣ Post-Compromise")
| extend IPs  = extract_all(@"(\b\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+\b)", strcat(IPAddress, " ", Detail)),
         Doms = extract_all(@"@([A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]+)", Detail)
| extend IPs = iff(isnull(IPs), dynamic([]), IPs), Doms = iff(isnull(Doms), dynamic([]), Doms)
| extend IOCs = strcat_array(set_difference(set_union(IPs, Doms), pack_array(UserDomain)), ", ")
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, RiskScore, Phase, Hits, Signal, Account, IPAddress, Location, DeviceName, App, Detail, IOCs, UserAgent
| sort by RiskScore desc, TimeGenerated desc

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
let LegacyClients = dynamic([
    "Exchange ActiveSync", "IMAP4", "POP3", "Authenticated SMTP", "Other clients",
    "Exchange Web Services", "AutoDiscover", "Offline Address Book",
    "Outlook Anywhere (RPC over HTTP)", "Exchange Online PowerShell"]);
let Base = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. {TimeRange:start})
    | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser and ResultType == "0";
let BaseCountries = toscalar(Base | summarize make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 200));
let BaseIPs = toscalar(Base | summarize make_set(IPAddress, 1000));
let BaseOSBrowser = toscalar(Base | summarize make_set(strcat(tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem), " | ",
    tostring(split(tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), " ")[0])), 200));
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
        | extend SignInType = "Interactive", Loc = LocationDetails, Dev = DeviceDetail),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
        | extend SignInType = "Non-interactive", Loc = todynamic(LocationDetails), Dev = todynamic(DeviceDetail))
| extend Country = tostring(Loc.countryOrRegion),
         Location = strcat(tostring(Loc.city), ", ", tostring(Loc.countryOrRegion)),
         OSBrowser = strcat(tostring(Dev.operatingSystem), " | ", tostring(split(tostring(Dev.browser), " ")[0])),
         DeviceName = tostring(Dev.displayName),
         Compliant = tostring(Dev.isCompliant),
         Success = ResultType == "0"
| extend Flags = strcat_array(array_concat(
    iff(Success and isnotempty(Country) and not(set_has_element(BaseCountries, Country)), dynamic(["🌍 New Country"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(Success and not(set_has_element(BaseIPs, IPAddress)), dynamic(["🆕 New IP"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(Success and not(set_has_element(BaseOSBrowser, OSBrowser)), dynamic(["💻 New OS/Browser"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(ClientAppUsed in (LegacyClients), dynamic(["🧓 Legacy Auth"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium", "high"), dynamic(["🚨 Risky"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(ResultType == "500121", dynamic(["📲 MFA Denied"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(Success and AuthenticationRequirement == "singleFactorAuthentication" and SignInType == "Interactive", dynamic(["🔓 Single-Factor"]), dynamic([]))), " ")
| summarize SignIns = count(),
            Failures = countif(not(Success)),
            Results = make_set(iff(Success, "Success", strcat(ResultType, " ", ResultDescription)), 5),
            Flags = take_any(Flags),
            Risk = take_any(RiskLevelDuringSignIn),
            CAStatus = take_any(ConditionalAccessStatus),
            UserAgent = take_any(UserAgent)
         by TimeGenerated = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), SignInType, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed,
            OSBrowser, DeviceName, Compliant
| extend RiskScore = toint(
    iff(Flags has "Risky", 3, 0) + iff(Flags has "New Country", 3, 0) + iff(Flags has "Legacy Auth", 2, 0)
    + iff(Flags has "MFA Denied", 2, 0) + iff(Flags has "New IP", 1, 0) + iff(Flags has "New OS", 1, 0)
    + iff(Flags has "Single-Factor", 1, 0))
| extend Severity = case(RiskScore >= 6, "🔴 High", RiskScore >= 3, "🟠 Medium", RiskScore >= 1, "🟡 Low", "⚪ Normal")
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, Flags, SignInType, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, SignIns, Failures,
          Results, OSBrowser, DeviceName, Compliant, Risk, CAStatus, UserAgent

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(TargetUser)
| extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)),
         Actor  = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)))
| where Target == TargetUser
| summarize Revoked  = maxif(TimeGenerated, OperationName has_any ("refresh tokens", "sign-in sessions", "Revoke")),
            PwReset  = maxif(TimeGenerated, OperationName has "password" and OperationName !has "security info" and Actor != Target),
            MfaReset = maxif(TimeGenerated, OperationName has "security info" and Actor != Target),
            Disabled = maxif(TimeGenerated, OperationName == "Disable account")
| where isnotempty(TargetUser)
| extend Contained = isnotnull(Revoked) and isnotnull(PwReset)
| extend Rows = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Order", 1, "Metric", "🧹 Contained", "Done", Contained, "When", ""),
    bag_pack("Order", 2, "Metric", "🔒 Sessions Revoked", "Done", isnotnull(Revoked), "When", format_datetime(Revoked, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")),
    bag_pack("Order", 3, "Metric", "🔐 Password Reset by Admin", "Done", isnotnull(PwReset), "When", format_datetime(PwReset, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")),
    bag_pack("Order", 4, "Metric", "📱 MFA Reset by Admin", "Done", isnotnull(MfaReset), "When", format_datetime(MfaReset, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")),
    bag_pack("Order", 5, "Metric", "⛔ Account Disabled", "Done", isnotnull(Disabled), "When", format_datetime(Disabled, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")))
| mv-expand Row = Rows
| extend Order = toint(Row.Order), Metric = tostring(Row.Metric), Done = tobool(Row.Done), When = tostring(Row.When)
| extend Status = case(Order == 1 and Done, "✅ Yes", Order == 1, "❌ No", Order == 5 and not(Done), "➖ No", Done, "✅ Done", "❌ Not done")
| sort by Order asc
| project Metric, Status, When

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
let Clicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where tolower(AccountUpn) == TargetUser
    | summarize Clicks = count(), ClickedThrough = countif(IsClickedThrough == true), ClickedUrls = make_set(Url, 3)
             by NetworkMessageId;
let PostDelivery = EmailPostDeliveryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where tolower(RecipientEmailAddress) == TargetUser
    | summarize PostDelivery = make_set(strcat(Action, " (", ActionType, ")"), 3) by NetworkMessageId;
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(TargetUser) and tolower(RecipientEmailAddress) == TargetUser
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| lookup kind=leftouter Clicks on NetworkMessageId
| lookup kind=leftouter PostDelivery on NetworkMessageId
| extend Clicks = coalesce(Clicks, 0), ClickedThrough = coalesce(ClickedThrough, 0)
| extend IsPhish = ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| extend SevRank = case(
    Clicks > 0 and (IsPhish or ClickedThrough > 0), 1,
    IsPhish and DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and DeliveryLocation has "Inbox", 2,
    DeliveryAction == "Delivered", 3,
    4)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Clicked", SevRank == 2, "🟠 In Inbox", SevRank == 3, "🟡 Delivered", "⚪ Blocked")
| sort by SevRank asc, TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation, SenderFromAddress, SenderIPv4, Subject,
          UrlCount, AttachmentCount, Clicks, ClickedThrough, ClickedUrls, PostDelivery, DetectionMethods, NetworkMessageId

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
let Id = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (IdentityInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where tolower(AccountUPN) == TargetUser),
        (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime)[])
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)
    | project pack_all());
let Ok = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser and ResultType == "0";
let Last = toscalar(Ok
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, LocationDetails)
    | project pack_all());
let Mfa = toscalar(Ok
    | mv-expand d = todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
    | extend Method = tostring(d.authenticationMethod)
    | where isnotempty(Method) and Method !in ("Previously satisfied", "Password")
    | summarize make_set(Method, 5));
print Rows = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Field", "User", "Value", TargetUser),
    bag_pack("Field", "DisplayName", "Value", tostring(Id.AccountDisplayName)),
    bag_pack("Field", "JobTitle", "Value", tostring(Id.JobTitle)),
    bag_pack("Field", "Department", "Value", tostring(Id.Department)),
    bag_pack("Field", "Manager", "Value", tostring(Id.Manager)),
    bag_pack("Field", "Location", "Value", strcat(tostring(Id.City), ", ", tostring(Id.Country))),
    bag_pack("Field", "AccountEnabled", "Value", tostring(Id.IsAccountEnabled)),
    bag_pack("Field", "Created", "Value", format_datetime(todatetime(Id.AccountCreationTime), "yyyy-MM-dd")),
    bag_pack("Field", "Roles", "Value", strcat_array(todynamic(Id.AssignedRoles), ", ")),
    bag_pack("Field", "Groups", "Value", tostring(array_length(todynamic(Id.GroupMembership)))),
    bag_pack("Field", "RiskLevel", "Value", strcat(tostring(Id.RiskLevel), " ", tostring(Id.RiskState))),
    bag_pack("Field", "MFAMethods (30d)", "Value", strcat_array(Mfa, ", ")),
    bag_pack("Field", "LastSignIn", "Value", strcat(format_datetime(todatetime(Last.TimeGenerated), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " | ",
        tostring(Last.IPAddress), " | ", tostring(Last.LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), " | ", tostring(Last.AppDisplayName))))
| where isnotempty(TargetUser)
| mv-expand Row = Rows
| project Field = tostring(Row.Field), Value = tostring(Row.Value)

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
let UserLocal = tostring(split(TargetUser, "@")[0]);
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where isnotempty(TargetUser) and tolower(UserPrincipalName) == TargetUser
        | extend Dev = DeviceDetail
        | extend Device = tolower(tostring(Dev.displayName))
        | where isnotempty(Device)
        | summarize SignIns = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
                    OS = take_any(tostring(Dev.operatingSystem)), Compliant = take_any(tostring(Dev.isCompliant)),
                    TrustType = take_any(tostring(Dev.trustType))
                 by Device
        | extend Logons = 0),
    (DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where isnotempty(UserLocal) and tolower(AccountName) == UserLocal

    | where isempty(SubjectText) or Subject contains SubjectText
    | where isempty(MessageId) or NetworkMessageId == MessageId or InternetMessageId contains MessageId;

    | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. now())

    | distinct NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress = tolower(RecipientEmailAddress)
    | extend IsRemoved = true;

| extend IsRemoved = coalesce(IsRemoved, false), IsThreat = isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| summarize Messages = dcount(NetworkMessageId), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), Senders = dcount(SenderFromAddress),
            Threats = countif(IsThreat),

            Junk = countif(DeliveryLocation has "Junk"),
            Blocked = countif(DeliveryAction == "Blocked"),

| extend Clicks = coalesce(tolong(C.Clicks), 0), Reached = coalesce(tolong(C.Reached), 0)

    bag_pack("Metric", "📨 Messages", "Value", Messages),

]);

    "www-data", "apache", "nginx", "postgres", "mysql", "nobody", "daemon",
    "guest", "defaultaccount", "wdagutilityaccount"
]);
union isfuzzy=true
// ============================================================
// TA0002 EXECUTION -- T1059 malicious PowerShell (download/encode/hidden)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "DownloadFile", "DownloadString", "DownloadData",
        "Invoke-Expression", "IEX", "iex(",
        "EncodedCommand", "-enc ", "-ec ",
        "FromBase64String",
        "Net.WebClient", "WebRequest", "Start-BitsTransfer",
        "Invoke-WebRequest", "curl ", "wget ")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "-WindowStyle Hidden"
            and ProcessCommandLine has "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "-NonInteractive"
            and ProcessCommandLine has "-NoProfile"
            and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http", "ftp", "\\\\"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "⚡ Malicious PowerShell", DeviceName,
              Account = AccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("PS: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 250))
),
// ============================================================

// ============================================================
// TA0003 PERSISTENCE -- T1053.005 / T1543 scheduled tasks & services
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "schtasks /create", "/sc onlogon", "/sc onstart",
        "/sc onstartup", "/ru system",
        "New-ScheduledTask", "Register-ScheduledTask",
        "sc create", "New-Service")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔧 Task/Service Persistence", DeviceName,

    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice

             ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/add", "/delete"))

        or ProcessCommandLine has "/active:yes"

        or ProcessCommandLine has_any (
            "New-LocalUser", "Add-LocalGroupMember",
            "Set-LocalUser", "Enable-LocalUser", "Disable-LocalUser",
            "Remove-LocalGroupMember",
            "net localgroup administrators",
            "net localgroup \"remote desktop users\"")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "👤 Account Manipulation", DeviceName,

              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,

),
// ============================================================
// TA0005 DEFENSE EVASION -- T1112 persistence/RDP/AV registry mods (reg.exe)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice

    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "UsbDriveMounted"
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "📤 Exfil/Collection", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = "",
              SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
              Detail = strcat("USB mounted | ", substring(tostring(AdditionalFields), 0, 180))
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0003 PERSISTENCE -- T1547.001 Startup folder drops
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed", "FileModified")
    | where FolderPath contains "\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup"
    | where not(FileName endswith ".ini")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🔧 Startup Persistence", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Startup drop: ", substring(FolderPath, 0, 200))
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0040 IMPACT -- T1486 mass file rename/modify by one process (encryption)
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed", "FileModified")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (TrustedProcs)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("explorer.exe", "OneDrive.exe", "ms-teams.exe",
        "Teams.exe", "msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "SearchProtocolHost.exe", "TiWorker.exe",
        "msiexec.exe", "Dropbox.exe")
    | summarize Files = count(),
                NewExts = dcount(extract(@"\.([^.\\]+)$", 1, FileName)),
                LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
                Cmd = take_any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
                Acct = take_any(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
                Hash = take_any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
                by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, Bin = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
    | where Files >= 200
    | project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Signal = "💥 Ransomware Prep", DeviceName,
              Account = Acct,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = Cmd,
              ChildProcess = "",
              SHA256 = Hash,
              Detail = strcat("Mass file change: ", Files, " files / ", NewExts,
                             " extensions in 5 min")
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0040 IMPACT -- T1486 ransom notes dropped across many folders
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)(read_?me|decrypt|restore|recover|how_to|ransom).*\.(txt|hta|html?)$"
    | summarize Folders = dcount(FolderPath), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
                Note = take_any(FileName),
                Proc = take_any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                Cmd = take_any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
                Acct = take_any(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
                Hash = take_any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
                by DeviceName, Bin = bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where Folders >= 10
    | project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Signal = "💥 Ransomware Prep", DeviceName,
              Account = Acct,
              InitiatingProcess = Proc,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = Cmd,
              ChildProcess = Note,
              SHA256 = Hash,
              Detail = strcat("Ransom-note pattern '", Note, "' in ", Folders, " folders")
),
// ============================================================
// v4.8 TA0005 DEFENSE EVASION -- T1068 / T1562 BYOVD: drivers loaded from unusual paths
// ============================================================
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "DriverLoad"
    | where not(FolderPath contains "\\System32\\drivers\\"
                or FolderPath contains "\\DriverStore\\"
                or FolderPath contains "\\WinSxS\\")
    | project TimeGenerated, Signal = "🧩 Suspicious Driver Load", DeviceName,
              Account = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName,
              SHA256,
              Detail = strcat("Driver: ", substring(FolderPath, 0, 200))
),
// --- Schema pin keeps union column order and types stable ---
(
    datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, Signal:string, DeviceName:string,
              Account:string, InitiatingProcess:string,
              InitiatingProcessCmd:string, ChildProcess:string,
              SHA256:string, ThreatName:string, Action:string, Detail:string)[]
)
// ============================================================
// NOISE SUPPRESSION - hard signals bypass this entirely
// ============================================================
| extend IsHardSignal = Signal has_any (HardSignalKeywords)
| extend IsBenignParent =
    InitiatingProcess in~ (BenignParents)
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains
        "\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\Content\\DetectionScripts\\"
    or (InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-ExecutionPolicy AllSigned"
        and InitiatingProcessCmd contains "SessionState.LanguageMode")
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "--msedgewebview"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "hpatchmonTask"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "RunCommandExtension"
    or Account =~ "mdatp"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "runuser -u mdatp"
    or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "/var/lib/dpkg/info/mdatp."
    or (InitiatingProcess =~ "svchost.exe"
        and (InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-s DPS"
             or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-s SysMain"
             or InitiatingProcessCmd contains "-s DiagTrack"))
| where IsHardSignal or not(IsBenignParent)
// ============================================================
// RISK SCORING - base weight per signal type + situational modifiers
// ============================================================
| extend BaseScore = case(
    Signal contains "Alert (High)", 8,
    Signal contains "Alert (Medium)", 6,
    Signal contains "Alert (Low)", 4,
    Signal contains "Alert (Info)", 3,
    Signal has "Initial Access", 8,
    Signal has "LOLBin Execution", 7,
    Signal has "Suspicious Driver", 7,
    Signal has "Startup Persistence", 6,
    Signal has "Privilege Escalation", 7,
    Signal has "Download & Execute", 7,
    Signal has "Cryptominer", 7,
    Signal has "Exfil", 6,
    Signal has "Offensive Tool", 5,
    Signal has "Logon After Failures", 8,
    Signal has "External Remote Logon", 7,
    Signal has "Brute Force", 6,
    Signal has "Service Account Logon", 6,
    Signal has "Process Injection", 6,
    Signal has "New Listener", 6,
    Signal has "Suspicious Port", 6,
    Signal has "Shell/Temp Egress", 6,
    Signal has "Network Scan", 6,
    Signal has "Credential Access", 9,
    Signal has "Ransomware Prep", 9,
    Signal has "Backdoor", 9,
    Signal has "Defense Evasion", 7,
    Signal has "Registry Modification", 7,
    Signal has "Lateral Movement", 7,
    Signal has "Tunneling Tool", 7,
    Signal has "Registry Persistence", 6,
    Signal has "Task/Service Persistence", 6,
    Signal has "Account Manipulation", 6,
    Signal has "Malicious PowerShell", 6,
    Signal has "LOLBin Network Egress", 6,
    Signal has "Defender Detection" and Detail startswith "AntivirusReport", 4,
    Signal has "Defender Detection", 6,
    Signal has "Unauthorized Remote Tool", 5,
    Signal has "Discovery/Recon", 4,
    3
)
| extend DiscoveryBoost = case(
    Signal has "Discovery/Recon" and Detail has "🔴", 3,
    Signal has "Discovery/Recon" and Detail has "🟠", 2,
    0
)
| extend RiskScore = min_of(BaseScore + DiscoveryBoost + iff(IsHardSignal, 2, 0), 10)
| extend Severity = case(RiskScore >= 9, "🔴 Critical",
                         RiskScore >= 7, "🟠 High",
                         RiskScore >= 5, "🟡 Medium", "⚪ Low")
// ============================================================
// IOC EXTRACTION - IPs and domains pulled from the full detail and parent
// command line (before truncation). Loopback and Azure platform IPs dropped.
// ============================================================
| extend IocText = strcat(Detail, " ", InitiatingProcessCmd)
| extend Cands = array_concat(
    extract_all(@"(\d\d?\d?\.\d\d?\d?\.\d\d?\d?\.\d\d?\d?)", IocText),
    extract_all(@"(?i)(?:https?|ftp)://([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*)", IocText),
    extract_all(@"(?i)->\s([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*)", IocText))
| mv-apply Ioc = Cands to typeof(string) on (
    where isnotempty(Ioc)
    | where not(Ioc startswith "127." or Ioc in ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255",
                                                 "169.254.169.254", "168.63.129.16"))
    | where isnotnull(parse_ipv4(Ioc)) or Ioc matches regex @"(?i)[a-z]"
    | summarize IOCs = make_set(Ioc, 10)
)
| extend IOCs = strcat_array(IOCs, ", ")
| project-away IocText, Cands
| extend ThreatName = coalesce(ThreatName, ""), Action = coalesce(Action, "")
| extend InitiatingProcessCmd = substring(InitiatingProcessCmd, 0, 120)
| extend Detail = substring(Detail, 0, 150)
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Hits = count()
    by Severity, RiskScore, Signal, ThreatName, Action, DeviceName, Account, Detail, IOCs,
       InitiatingProcess, InitiatingProcessCmd, ChildProcess, SHA256,
       TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Severity, RiskScore, Hits, Signal, DeviceName, Account,
          Detail, IOCs, InitiatingProcess, InitiatingProcessCmd, ChildProcess, SHA256, ThreatName, Action
| sort by RiskScore desc, TimeGenerated desc

content.query:
let Inc = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *),
                FirstAck = minif(TimeGenerated, Status != "New" or isnotempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)))
             by IncidentNumber
    | extend MTTD = datetime_diff("minute", CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime) / 60.0,
             MTTA = datetime_diff("minute", FirstAck, CreatedTime) / 60.0,
             MTTR = iff(Status == "Closed", datetime_diff("minute", ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, real(null));
Inc
| summarize MTTD = avgif(MTTD, MTTD >= 0),
            MTTA = avgif(MTTA, MTTA >= 0),
            MTTR = avgif(MTTR, MTTR >= 0),
            Closed = countif(Status == "Closed"),
            Classified = countif(isnotempty(Classification)),
            TP = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
            BP = countif(Classification == "BenignPositive"),
            FP = countif(Classification == "FalsePositive")
| extend Rows = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "🔎 MTTD", "Value", iff(isnan(MTTD) or isnull(MTTD), "-", strcat(round(MTTD, 1), " h"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "⏱️ MTTA", "Value", iff(isnan(MTTA) or isnull(MTTA), "-", strcat(round(MTTA, 1), " h"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🏁 MTTR", "Value", iff(isnan(MTTR) or isnull(MTTR), "-", strcat(round(MTTR, 1), " h"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "✅ Closed", "Value", tostring(Closed)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🎯 True Positive", "Value", iff(Classified == 0, "-", strcat(round(100.0 * TP / Classified, 0), "%"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "🟢 Benign Positive", "Value", iff(Classified == 0, "-", strcat(round(100.0 * BP / Classified, 0), "%"))),
    bag_pack("Metric", "⚪ False Positive", "Value", iff(Classified == 0, "-", strcat(round(100.0 * FP / Classified, 0), "%"))))
| mv-expand Row = Rows
| project Metric = tostring(Row.Metric), Value = tostring(Row.Value)

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let ExecutableFileExtensions = dynamic([
    "bat", "cmd", "com", "cpl", "dll", "ex", "exe",
    "hta", "jar", "js", "jse", "lnk", "msc", "msi",
    "ps1", "py", "reg", "scr", "vb", "vbe", "vbs",
    "ws", "wsf", "iso", "img"
]);
// === Tor exit node list (official Tor Project) ===
let TorExitNodes = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://check.torproject.org/torbulkexitlist"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
let TorPorts = dynamic([9001, 9030, 9040, 9050, 9051, 9150, 9151]);
let TorProcesses = dynamic([
    "tor.exe", "torbrowser.exe", "firefox.exe",   // Tor Browser uses Firefox ESR
    "obfs4proxy.exe", "meek-client.exe", "snowflake-client.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType == "NetworkSignatureInspected"
| extend
    SignatureName           = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).SignatureName),
    SignatureMatchedContent = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).SignatureMatchedContent),
    SamplePacketContent     = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).SamplePacketContent)
| where SignatureName == "HTTP_Client"
// --- Parse request method & downloaded file ---
| extend HTTP_Request_Method = tostring(split(SignatureMatchedContent, " /", 0)[0])
| where HTTP_Request_Method == "GET"
| extend DownloadedContent = extract(@'.*/(.*)HTTP', 1, SignatureMatchedContent)
| extend DownloadFileExtension = tolower(extract(@'.*\.(.*)$', 1, DownloadedContent))
// --- Executable/script downloads only ---
| where isnotempty(DownloadFileExtension)
    and string_size(DownloadFileExtension) < 8
    and DownloadFileExtension has_any (ExecutableFileExtensions)
// --- Exclude known-good update/CDN destinations ---
| where not(SignatureMatchedContent has_any (
    "microsoft.com", "windowsupdate.com", "msftncsi.com",
    "azureedge.net", "akamai", "windows.com",
    "digicert.com", "symantec.com"
))
// --- Tor correlation ---
| extend
    IsTorExitNode  = RemoteIP in (TorExitNodes),
    IsTorPort      = RemotePort in (TorPorts),
    IsTorProcess   = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (TorProcesses)
| extend IsTorRelated = IsTorExitNode or IsTorPort or IsTorProcess
// --- Enrich / flag indicators ---
| extend
    IsRawIPDownload   = isnotempty(RemoteIP) and RemoteUrl == "",
    IsHighRiskExt     = DownloadFileExtension in~ ("exe", "dll", "scr", "ps1", "hta", "js", "vbs", "lnk", "iso"),
    IsRemoteExternal  = RemoteIPType == "Public"
// --- Risk Score (Tor weighted heavily) ---
| extend RiskScore = 2
                   + (toint(IsHighRiskExt) * 2)
                   + (toint(IsRawIPDownload) * 2)
                   + (toint(IsRemoteExternal) * 1)
                   + (toint(IsTorExitNode) * 4)     // download FROM a Tor exit node
                   + (toint(IsTorPort) * 3)
                   + (toint(IsTorProcess) * 2)
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 7, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 4, "🟠 High",
    "🟡 Medium"
)
// --- Deduplicate ---
| summarize
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated),
    DownloadCount  = count(),
    RemoteIPs      = make_set(RemoteIP, 20),
    Files          = make_set(DownloadedContent, 20)
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
       DownloadFileExtension, Severity, RiskScore,
       IsHighRiskExt, IsRawIPDownload,
       IsTorRelated, IsTorExitNode, IsTorPort, IsTorProcess
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    DownloadCount,
    DeviceName,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    DownloadFileExtension,
    IsTorRelated,
    IsTorExitNode,
    IsTorPort,
    IsTorProcess,
    Files,
    RemoteIPs,
    IsHighRiskExt,
    IsRawIPDownload
| sort by RiskScore desc, DownloadCount desc

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let MgmtPaths = dynamic([
    "\\Windows\\CCM\\",
    "\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\",
    "\\Program Files\\Microsoft Monitoring Agent\\",
    "\\Windows\\System32\\GroupPolicy\\"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where FileName in~ (
    "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe",
    "mshta.exe", "installutil.exe", "regasm.exe", "regsvcs.exe",
    "cmstp.exe", "odbcconf.exe", "msxsl.exe", "wmic.exe",
    "forfiles.exe", "pcalua.exe", "msbuild.exe", "presentationhost.exe",
    "msdt.exe", "hh.exe", "ieexec.exe", "xwizard.exe", "diskshadow.exe"
)
// Strip the binary's own name so its ".exe" doesn't self-match
| extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
| extend LowerArgs = tolower(CmdArgs)
| extend Technique = case(
    // --- certutil: download / decode (highest confidence) ---
    FileName =~ "certutil.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("-urlcache", "urlcache", "-verifyctl", "verifyctl")
        and LowerArgs has_any ("http://", "https://", "ftp://"),
        "🔴 certutil Download",
    FileName =~ "certutil.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("-decode", "decode", "-encode", "encode"),
        "🔴 certutil Encode/Decode",
    // --- regsvr32 Squiblydoo: remote scriptlet execution ---
    FileName =~ "regsvr32.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("scrobj.dll", "/i:http", "/i:ftp", "i:http"),
        "🔴 regsvr32 Squiblydoo (remote scriptlet)",
    FileName =~ "regsvr32.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("http://", "https://"),
        "🔴 regsvr32 Remote Load",
    // --- mshta: remote or inline script execution ---
    FileName =~ "mshta.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("http://", "https://", "javascript:", "vbscript:"),
        "🔴 mshta Remote/Inline Script",
    // --- rundll32 abuse patterns ---
    FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("javascript:", "vbscript:", "mshtml"),
        "🔴 rundll32 Script Protocol",
    FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and LowerArgs has "comsvcs" and LowerArgs has "minidump",
        "🔴 rundll32 comsvcs LSASS Dump",
    FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("url.dll", "openurl", "shell32.dll,shellexec"),
        "🟠 rundll32 URL/Shell Execution",
    FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and LowerArgs matches regex
        @"(?i)[a-z]:\\(?:users|programdata|windows\\temp)\\[^,]*\.(?:dll|tmp|dat|log|txt|png|jpg),",
        "🔴 rundll32 DLL from User-Writable Path",
    // --- bitsadmin: background transfer ---
    FileName =~ "bitsadmin.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("/transfer", "/addfile", "/create", "transfer"),
        "🔴 bitsadmin Transfer",
    // --- .NET LOLBins: proxy execution of managed assemblies ---
    FileName in~ ("installutil.exe", "regasm.exe", "regsvcs.exe")
        and LowerArgs has_any ("/logfile=", "/u ", "/logtoconsole=false", ".dll", ".exe"),
        "🔴 .NET LOLBin Proxy Execution",
    // --- msbuild inline task ---
    FileName =~ "msbuild.exe" and LowerArgs has_any (".xml", ".csproj", ".proj", ".targets")
        and not(InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (MgmtPaths)),
        "🟠 msbuild Project Execution",
    // --- wmic XSL execution ---
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("/format:http", "/format:\\\\", "format:http"),
        "🔴 wmic Remote XSL Execution",
    // --- cmstp / odbcconf / msxsl ---
    FileName =~ "cmstp.exe" and LowerArgs has_any (".inf", "/s", "/ns"),
        "🔴 cmstp INF Execution",
    FileName =~ "odbcconf.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("/a", "regsvr", ".rsp"),
        "🔴 odbcconf DLL Registration",
    FileName =~ "msxsl.exe",
        "🟠 msxsl XSL Execution",
    // --- process launchers used to break parent-child chains ---
    FileName in~ ("forfiles.exe", "pcalua.exe", "xwizard.exe")
        and LowerArgs has_any ("/c ", "-a ", "runwizard", ".exe", "cmd", "powershell"),
        "🟠 Process Launcher Proxy",
    // --- msdt (Follina-class) ---
    FileName =~ "msdt.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("ms-msdt", "it_rebrowseforfile", "it_browseforfile"),
        "🔴 msdt Diagnostic Abuse",
    // --- diskshadow scripted mode ---
    FileName =~ "diskshadow.exe" and LowerArgs has_any ("/s ", "-s "),
        "🟠 diskshadow Script Mode",
    "⚪ Other"
)
| where Technique != "⚪ Other"
// Exclude signed management tooling running these legitimately
| where not(InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (MgmtPaths))
// --- Supporting context ---
| extend
    HasUrl = CmdArgs has_any ("http://", "https://", "ftp://"),
    HasUncPath = CmdArgs contains "\\\\",
    FromUserWritable = FolderPath has_any (
        "\\Temp\\", "\\AppData\\", "\\Downloads\\", "\\Public\\", "\\ProgramData\\"),
    SuspiciousParent = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
        "winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe", "onenote.exe",
        "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "chrome.exe", "msedge.exe"),
    IsElevated = ProcessIntegrityLevel in ("High", "System"),
    IsHighConfidence = Technique startswith "🔴"
| extend RiskScore = 4
                   + (toint(IsHighConfidence) * 3)
                   + (toint(SuspiciousParent) * 4)
                   + (toint(HasUrl) * 2)
                   + (toint(FromUserWritable) * 2)
                   + (toint(HasUncPath) * 1)
                   + (toint(IsElevated) * 1)
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 11, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 8,  "🟠 High",
    RiskScore >= 6,  "🟡 Medium",
    "🟢 Low"
)
| summarize
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated),
    OccurrenceCount = count(),
    Commands        = make_set(substring(CmdArgs, 0, 250), 3),
    Devices         = dcount(DeviceName)
    by Severity, RiskScore, Technique, IsHighConfidence,
       DeviceName, Account = AccountName, LolBin = FileName,
       ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
       SuspiciousParent, HasUrl, FromUserWritable
| project
    FirstSeen,
    Severity,
    OccurrenceCount,
    Technique,
    DeviceName,
    Account,
    LolBin,
    ParentProcess,
    SuspiciousParent,
    HasUrl,
    FromUserWritable,
    Commands,
    RiskScore,
    IsHighConfidence,
    LastSeen
| sort by RiskScore desc, OccurrenceCount desc

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let FileThreshold = 4;          // min distinct remote paths in the window
let TimeWindowBin = 10m;
DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
// --- PsExec-style execution (accepteula is the classic tell) ---
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "accepteula",
    "psexec",
    "paexec",
    "-s -d",            // PsExec system + detached
    "\\\\*\\admin$",    // pushing to admin share
    "\\\\*\\c$"
)
// --- Dropped to a remote machine (UNC path) and is an executable ---
| where FolderPath has "\\\\"
| where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".bat" or FileName endswith ".cmd" or FileName endswith ".dll"
// --- Count executables referenced in the command line ---
| extend ExeCount = countof(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ".exe")
| extend BatCount = countof(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ".bat")
// --- Multiple binaries OR a batch script involved ---
| where (InitiatingProcessCommandLine !has ".ps1" and ExeCount > 1)
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has ".bat"
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has ".cmd"
// --- Exclusions (remove lines to widen scope) ---
| where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "batch", "auditpol", "script", "scripts",
    "illusive", "rebootrequired",
    "SccmClient", "ccmsetup", "MonitoringHost"   // common legit admin tools
))
// --- Flag suspicious indicators ---
| extend
    IsSuspiciousPath = FolderPath has_any (
        "\\temp\\", "\\tmp\\", "\\public\\",
        "\\windows\\temp\\", "\\programdata\\"
    ),
    IsAdminShare = FolderPath has_any ("admin$", "c$", "ipc$")
// --- Summarize per device per 10-min window ---
| summarize
    StartTime       = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime         = max(TimeGenerated),
    FileCount       = dcount(FolderPath),
    TotalEvents     = count(),
    DistinctHashes  = dcount(SHA1),
    Hashes          = make_set(SHA1, 50),
    Paths           = make_set(FolderPath, 50),
    Files           = make_set(FileName, 50),
    CommandLines    = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 20),
    AnySuspiciousPath = max(IsSuspiciousPath),
    AnyAdminShare     = max(IsAdminShare)
    by DeviceId, DeviceName,
       TimeWindow = bin(TimeGenerated, TimeWindowBin),
       InitiatingProcessFileName,
       InitiatingProcessAccountName
// --- Only mass-drop events ---
| where FileCount > FileThreshold
// --- Risk Score ---
| extend RiskScore = 3                                  // base: PsExec mass drop
                   + toint(AnySuspiciousPath)
                   + toint(AnyAdminShare)
                   + iff(FileCount > 10, 3, 0)          // very high file count
                   + iff(DistinctHashes > 5, 2, 0)      // many unique binaries
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 7, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 5, "🟠 High",
    "🟡 Medium"
)
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    DeviceName,
    InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    FileCount,
    TotalEvents,
    DistinctHashes,
    AnySuspiciousPath,
    AnyAdminShare,
    Files,
    Paths,
    CommandLines,
    Hashes
| sort by RiskScore desc, FileCount desc

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let TI_IPs = ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | distinct NetworkIP;
let Feodo_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://feodotracker.abuse.ch/downloads/ipblocklist.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
let SSLBL_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://sslbl.abuse.ch/blacklist/sslipblacklist.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
let Blocklist_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://lists.blocklist.de/lists/all.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
let MaliciousIPs = materialize(
    union
        (TI_IPs | project MalIP = NetworkIP),
        (Feodo_IPs | project MalIP = Indicator),
        (SSLBL_IPs | project MalIP = Indicator),
        (Blocklist_IPs | project MalIP = Indicator)
    | distinct MalIP
);
let SystemPaths = dynamic([
    "\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\",
    "\\Windows\\AppRepository\\",
    "\\Microsoft\\Diagnosis\\",
    "\\Windows\\System32\\config\\",
    "\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\",
    "\\Windows\\WinSxS\\",
    "\\Windows\\servicing\\"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where RemoteIP in (MaliciousIPs)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
    "chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe",
    "brave.exe", "opera.exe", "tor.exe", "torbrowser.exe",
    "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe",
    "curl.exe", "wget.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe"
)
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileDownloaded")
    | where
        // --- Credential / secret files ---
        FileName endswith ".env"
        or FileName endswith ".pem"
        or FileName endswith ".key"
        or FileName endswith ".pfx"
        or FileName endswith ".p12"
        or FileName endswith ".kdbx"
        or FileName endswith ".ppk"
        or FileName endswith ".ovpn"
        or FileName endswith ".rdp"
        // --- General config files ---
        or FileName endswith ".config"
        or FileName endswith ".conf"
        or FileName endswith ".cfg"
        or FileName endswith ".ini"
    | where FileName !in~ (
        ".ADOBE_WEBVIEW_FLAGS_SERVER.CONFIG",
        "ACSLEng.cfg",
        "LogTransport2.cfg",
        "STDeploy.exe.config"
    )
    | extend FileCategory = case(
        FileName endswith ".env" or FileName endswith ".pem" or FileName endswith ".key"
            or FileName endswith ".pfx" or FileName endswith ".p12"
            or FileName endswith ".kdbx" or FileName endswith ".ppk"
            or FileName endswith ".ovpn" or FileName endswith ".rdp", "🔑 Credential/Secret",
        "⚙️ General Config"
    )
    | project
        FileTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
        DeviceName,
        FileName,
        FolderPath,
        FileCategory,
        FileSHA256 = SHA256
) on DeviceName
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, FileTimestamp)) <= 600
// --- Exclude Microsoft system paths ---
| where not(FolderPath has_any (SystemPaths))
| extend RiskScore = case(
    FileCategory == "🔑 Credential/Secret", 10,
    8
)
| extend Severity = "🔴 Critical"
// --- Deduplicate ---
| summarize
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    RemotePorts      = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
    Processes        = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
    by DeviceName, RemoteIP, FileName, FolderPath, FileCategory, FileSHA256, Severity, RiskScore
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    ConnectionCount,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    FileCategory,
    DeviceName,
    RemoteIP,
    RemotePorts,
    Processes,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    FileSHA256
| sort by RiskScore desc, LastSeen desc

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
// --- Command execution patterns (non-capturing groups) ---
let CmdPatterns = "(?i)(?:net(?:1)?(?:\\.exe)?(?:%20|\\s|\\+)+(?:user|group|localgroup|view|share))|(?:cmd(?:\\.exe)?(?:%20|\\s|\\+)+/c)|(?:powershell(?:\\.exe)?)|(?:whoami)|(?:ipconfig)|(?:systeminfo)|(?:tasklist)|(?:certutil)|(?:bitsadmin)|(?:nltest)|(?:wmic)|(?:reg(?:\\.exe)?(?:%20|\\s|\\+)+query)";
W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or Computer has TargetDevice
| where csUriQuery matches regex CmdPatterns
    or csUriStem matches regex CmdPatterns
    or csReferer matches regex CmdPatterns
| extend
    MatchedField = case(
        csUriQuery matches regex CmdPatterns, "csUriQuery",
        csUriStem matches regex CmdPatterns,  "csUriStem",
        csReferer matches regex CmdPatterns,  "csReferer",
        "Unknown"
    ),
    IsWebShellExt = (csUriStem has_any (".aspx", ".asp", ".ashx", ".asmx", ".php", ".jsp")),
    IsKnownWebShell = (csUriStem has_any (
        "cmd.aspx", "shell.aspx", "webshell", "antsword",
        "c99", "r57", "b374k", "wso",
        "eval", "tunnel.aspx"
    )),
    IsEncoded = (csUriQuery has_any ("%20", "%2f", "%5c", "base64", "FromBase64", "-enc", "-ec"))
| extend RiskScore = 2
                   + (toint(IsWebShellExt) * 2)
                   + (toint(IsKnownWebShell) * 4)
                   + (toint(IsEncoded) * 2)
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 6, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 4, "🟠 High",
    "🟡 Medium"
)
| summarize
    StartTime       = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime         = max(TimeGenerated),
    ConnectionCount = count(),
    DistinctUris    = dcount(csUriStem),
    SampleQueries   = make_set(csUriQuery, 10),
    StatusCodes     = make_set(scStatus, 10)
    by Computer, sSiteName, sIP, cIP, csUserName,
       csMethod, MatchedField,
       IsWebShellExt, IsKnownWebShell, IsEncoded,
       Severity, RiskScore
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    ConnectionCount,
    DistinctUris,
    Computer,
    sSiteName,
    sIP,
    cIP,
    csUserName,
    csMethod,
    MatchedField,
    IsWebShellExt,
    IsKnownWebShell,
    IsEncoded,
    StatusCodes,
    SampleQueries
| sort by RiskScore desc, ConnectionCount desc
