content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let EdrProcesses = dynamic([
    "MsMpEng.exe", "MsSense.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "SenseCncProxy.exe",
    "CSFalconService.exe", "CSFalconContainer.exe",
    "SentinelAgent.exe", "SentinelServiceHost.exe", "SentinelStaticEngine.exe",
    "cb.exe", "RepMgr.exe", "RepUx.exe", "CylanceSvc.exe",
    "SophosHealth.exe", "SAVService.exe", "McShield.exe", "mfemms.exe",
    "ccSvcHst.exe", "SmcGui.exe", "xagt.exe", "TmCCSF.exe", "elastic-agent.exe"
]);
let EdrServices = dynamic([
    "WinDefend", "Sense", "WdNisSvc", "SecurityHealthService", "wscsvc",
    "CSFalconService", "SentinelAgent", "CbDefense", "CylanceSvc",
    "SAVService", "McAfeeFramework", "SepMasterService", "xagt"
]);
let VulnerableDrivers = dynamic([
    "rtcore64.sys", "rtkvhd64.sys", "gdrv.sys", "iqvw64e.sys", "dbutil_2_3.sys",
    "mhyprot2.sys", "procexp152.sys", "aswarpot.sys", "truesight.sys",
    "viragt64.sys", "kprocesshacker.sys", "gmer64.sys", "nvflash.sys",
    "elrawdsk.sys", "atillk64.sys", "speedfan.sys", "winio64.sys"
]);
let EdrKillerTools = dynamic([
    "aukill.exe", "terminator.exe", "edrkillshifter.exe", "edrsilencer.exe",
    "backstab.exe", "edrsandblast.exe", "gmer.exe", "processhacker.exe",
    "pchunter64.exe", "kdu.exe", "spyboy.exe", "zam64.sys"
]);
union isfuzzy=true
// 1. BYOVD - vulnerable signed driver loaded
(
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName has_any (VulnerableDrivers)
    | extend Technique = "🔴 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Load",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat("Driver: ", FileName, " | Path: ", FolderPath, " | By: ", InitiatingProcessFileName), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail
),
// 1b. BYOVD - vulnerable driver dropped
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName has_any (VulnerableDrivers)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Dropped",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat("Driver: ", FileName, " | Path: ", FolderPath, " | By: ", InitiatingProcessFileName), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail
),
// 2. EDR-killer tooling
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where tolower(FileName) in~ (EdrKillerTools)
        or (CmdArgs has_any (EdrKillerTools) and CmdArgs has_any (EdrProcesses))
    | extend Technique = "🔴 EDR-Killer Tool Execution",
             RiskScore = 10,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs, " | Path: ", FolderPath), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 3. EDR process termination
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe", "tskill.exe", "wmic.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "pskill.exe", "pskill64.exe")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (EdrProcesses)
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("/f", "/im", "/pid", "Stop-Process", "kill", "terminate", "-Force")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 EDR Process Termination",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 4. EDR service stop / disable
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where FileName in~ ("sc.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "reg.exe")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (EdrServices)
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("stop", "delete", "disabled", "start= disabled", "Stop-Service", "Set-Service", "config", "Remove-Service")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 EDR Service Stop / Disable",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 5. Defender tampering
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (
        "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DisableBehaviorMonitoring",
        "DisableIOAVProtection", "DisableScriptScanning",
        "DisableArchiveScanning", "DisableBlockAtFirstSeen",
        "DisableAntiSpyware", "DisableAntiVirus",
        "TamperProtection", "MpEnablePus",
        "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath", "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionProcess",
        "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionExtension",
        "AmsiScanBuffer", "amsiInitFailed", "AmsiUtils"
    )
    | extend IsExclusion = CmdArgs has "ExclusionPath" or CmdArgs has "ExclusionProcess" or CmdArgs has "ExclusionExtension"
    | extend Technique = iff(IsExclusion, "🟠 Defender Exclusion Added", "🔴 Defender Protection Disabled"),
             RiskScore = iff(IsExclusion, 7, 9),
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 6. Safe Mode abuse
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("bcdedit", "safeboot", "bootstatuspolicy")
    | where CmdArgs has_any ("/set", "safeboot network", "safeboot minimal", "-set")
    | extend Technique = "🔴 Safe Mode Boot Configuration",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 7. Event log / telemetry tampering
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend CmdArgs = replace_regex(ProcessCommandLine, @'(?i)^\s*"?[^"]*?\.exe"?', "")
    | where CmdArgs has_any (
        "wevtutil cl", "wevtutil sl", "Clear-EventLog", "Remove-EventLog",
        "auditpol /clear", "auditpol /remove", "auditpol /set",
        "fsutil usn deletejournal", "EtwEventWrite", "PatchTraceLogging"
    )
    | extend Technique = "🔴 Event Log / ETW Tampering",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(FileName, " | ", CmdArgs), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName, ProcessName = FileName, Detail
),
// 8. Native Defender tamper events
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in (
        "AntivirusDisabled", "AntivirusConfigurationChange",
        "TamperingAttempt", "SecurityLogCleared",
        "AntivirusScanCancelled", "AntivirusEmergencyUpdatesInstalled"
    )
    | extend Technique = "🔴 Native Defender Tamper Event",
             RiskScore = 9,
             Detail = substring(strcat(ActionType, " | ", tostring(AdditionalFields)), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Technique, RiskScore, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ProcessName = InitiatingProcessFileName, Detail
)
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 9, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 7, "🟠 High",
    "🟡 Medium"
)
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    OccurrenceCount = count(),
    Details = make_set(Detail, 3)
    by Technique, Severity, RiskScore, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessName
| project
    FirstSeen,
    Severity,
    OccurrenceCount,
    Technique,
    DeviceName,
    AccountName,
    ProcessName,
    Details,
    RiskScore,
    LastSeen
| sort by RiskScore desc, OccurrenceCount desc
content.title: 🥷 EDR Evasions

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "powershell_ise.exe")
// --- Web download methods ---
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "Invoke-WebRequest", "iwr", "wget", "curl",
    "DownloadFile", "DownloadString", "DownloadData",
    "Net.WebClient", "Net.Http", "HttpClient",
    "Start-BitsTransfer", "Invoke-RestMethod", "irm"
)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://", "ftp://")
// --- HARD EXCLUSIONS: pure noise, removed entirely ---
| where not(ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "microsoft.com", "windowsupdate.com", "office.com",
    "live.com", "azure.com", "azureedge.net",
    "nuget.org", "powershellgallery.com",
    "visualstudio.com", "msftconnecttest.com"
))
// --- Exclude connectivity checks ---
| where not(ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "google.com", "gstatic.com", "connectivitycheck"
) and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "OpenRead", "CanRead", "GetResponse", "CheckConnectivity"
))
// --- Extract the URL & domain from the command ---
| extend ExtractedUrl = extract(@"(https?://[^\s'""\)]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ExtractedDomain = tolower(extract(@"https?://([^/:\s'""\)]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine))
// --- SCORING ALLOWLIST: legitimate but still visible if stacked ---
| extend IsKnownTrustedDomain = ExtractedDomain has_any (
    // CDNs & infrastructure commonly seen in legit scripts
    "akamai", "cloudfront.net", "fastly", "jsdelivr.net", "cdnjs",
    "amazonaws.com", "core.windows.net", "digicert.com",
    "letsencrypt.org", "sectigo.com", "verisign",
    // Package / dev ecosystems
    "python.org", "pypi.org", "pythonhosted.org",
    "nodejs.org", "npmjs.org", "chocolatey.org",
    "docker.io", "docker.com", "jenkins.io",
    "github.com", "githubusercontent.com",
    // Common vendor domains (tune to environment)
    "adobe.com", "mozilla.org", "ubuntu.com", "debian.org", "redhat.com"
)
// --- High-risk indicators ---
| extend
    IsExternalSource = iff(
        isnotempty(ExtractedDomain) and not(IsKnownTrustedDomain), "YES", ""),
    IsMaliciousFileType = ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        ".exe", ".ps1", ".bat", ".vbs", ".dll",
        ".msi", ".hta", ".js", ".lnk", ".zip", ".rar", ".scr"
    ),
    IsSuspiciousPath = ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "\\temp\\", "\\tmp\\", "\\appdata\\",
        "\\public\\", "\\downloads\\", "\\programdata\\",
        "%temp%", "%appdata%", "%public%"
    ),
    IsEncoded = ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "-enc", "-ec", "EncodedCommand",
        "FromBase64String", "ToBase64String",
        "[char]", "-join", "-replace"
    ),
    IsBypassAttempt = ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "bypass", "unrestricted", "hidden",
        "noprofile", "noninteractive", "-nop", "-w hidden"
    ),
    IsChainedExecution = ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "iex", "Invoke-Expression",
        "Start-Process", "& (", "| iex",
        ".Run(", "Shellexecute"
    ),
    IsRawIPorSuspiciousTLD = ProcessCommandLine matches regex
        @"https?://\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|\.tk|\.ru|\.cn|\.top|\.xyz|\.pw|\.cc|\.zip|\.mov",
    // --- parent process is a major phishing signal ---
    IsOfficeParent = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
        "winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe",
        "outlook.exe", "onenote.exe", "mspub.exe", "msaccess.exe"
    ),
    IsScriptHostParent = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
        "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "cmd.exe"
    )
// --- Risk Score ---
| extend RiskScore = toint(IsMaliciousFileType)
                   + toint(IsSuspiciousPath)
                   + (iff(IsExternalSource == "YES", 1, 0) * 3)
                   + (toint(IsEncoded) * 2)
                   + (toint(IsBypassAttempt) * 2)
                   + (toint(IsChainedExecution) * 2)
                   + (toint(IsRawIPorSuspiciousTLD) * 3)
                   + (toint(IsOfficeParent) * 4)        // Office spawning PS = classic phishing
                   + (toint(IsScriptHostParent) * 2)
| where RiskScore >= 2
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 7, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 4, "🟠 High",
    "🟡 Medium"
)
// --- Deduplicate ---
| summarize
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated),
    OccurrenceCount = count()
    by DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
       ExtractedDomain, ExtractedUrl,
       InitiatingProcessFileName,
       IsExternalSource, IsMaliciousFileType, IsSuspiciousPath, IsEncoded,
       IsBypassAttempt, IsChainedExecution, IsRawIPorSuspiciousTLD,
       IsOfficeParent, IsScriptHostParent,
       Severity, RiskScore
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    OccurrenceCount,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    DeviceName,
    AccountName,
    ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
    ExtractedDomain,
    ExtractedUrl,
    ProcessCommandLine,
    IsExternalSource,
    IsOfficeParent,
    IsMaliciousFileType,
    IsSuspiciousPath,
    IsEncoded,
    IsBypassAttempt,
    IsChainedExecution,
    IsRawIPorSuspiciousTLD
| sort by RiskScore desc, OccurrenceCount desc

let GetServices = materialize (

| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName contains "services.exe"
| where not(replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), " ", "") has_any (KnownProc))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, StartedChildProcess = FileName, StartedChildProcessSHA1 = SHA1, StartedChildProcessCmdline = ProcessCommandLine, ServiceProcessSHA1 = InitiatingProcessSHA1, ServiceProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, ServiceProcessCmdline = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ServiceProcessID = InitiatingProcessId, ServiceProcessCreationTime = InitiatingProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName, ServiceProcessFolderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath
);
GetServices
| summarize RunCount = count() by ServiceProcess, DeviceName
| where RunCount < 6
| join kind = inner GetServices on ServiceProcess, DeviceName
| join kind = leftouter (
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName contains "services.exe"
| where not(replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), " ", "") has_any (KnownProc))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, ServiceProcessSHA1 = InitiatingProcessSHA1, ServiceProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, ServiceProcessCmdline = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ServiceProcessID = InitiatingProcessId, ServiceProcessCreationTime = InitiatingProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName, NetworkAction = ActionType, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl
) on DeviceName, ServiceProcess, ServiceProcessCmdline, ServiceProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessID, ServiceProcessUser, ServiceProcessSHA1

DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName contains "services.exe"
| where not(replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), " ", "") has_any (KnownProc))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, ServiceProcessSHA1 = InitiatingProcessSHA1, ServiceProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, ServiceProcessCmdline = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ServiceProcessID = InitiatingProcessId, ServiceProcessCreationTime = InitiatingProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileAction = ActionType, ModifiedFile = FileName, ModifiedFileSHA1 = SHA1, ModifiedFilePath = FolderPath
) on DeviceName, ServiceProcess, ServiceProcessCmdline, ServiceProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessID, ServiceProcessUser, ServiceProcessSHA1
| join kind = leftouter (
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName contains "services.exe"
| where not(replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), " ", "") has_any (KnownProc))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, ServiceProcessSHA1 = InitiatingProcessSHA1, ServiceProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, ServiceProcessCmdline = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ServiceProcessID = InitiatingProcessId, ServiceProcessCreationTime = InitiatingProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName, LoadedDLL = FileName, LoadedDLLSHA1 = SHA1, LoadedDLLPath = FolderPath
) on DeviceName, ServiceProcess, ServiceProcessCmdline, ServiceProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessID, ServiceProcessUser, ServiceProcessSHA1
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ServiceProcessCreationTime), ConnectedAddresses = make_set(RemoteIP, 100), ConnectedUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 100), FilesModified = make_set(ModifiedFile, 100), FileModFolderPath = make_set(ModifiedFilePath, 100), FileModSHA1s = make_set(ModifiedFileSHA1, 100), ChildProcesses = make_set(StartedChildProcess, 100), ChildCommandlines = make_set(StartedChildProcessCmdline, 100), DLLsLoaded = make_set(LoadedDLL, 100), DLLSHA1 = make_set(LoadedDLLSHA1, 100) by DeviceName, ServiceProcess, ServiceProcessCmdline, ServiceProcessCreationTime, ServiceProcessID, ServiceProcessUser, ServiceProcessSHA1, ServiceProcessFolderPath
// --- Risk signals for severity ---
| extend
    RanFromSuspiciousPath = ServiceProcessFolderPath has_any ("\\temp\\", "\\tmp\\", "\\appdata\\", "\\programdata\\", "\\public\\", "\\users\\", "\\downloads\\", "\\perflogs\\"),
    HasExternalNetwork = array_length(ConnectedAddresses) > 0 or array_length(ConnectedUrls) > 0,
    SpawnedChildren = array_length(ChildProcesses) > 0,
    ModifiedFiles = array_length(FilesModified) > 0
| extend Severity = case(
    RanFromSuspiciousPath and HasExternalNetwork, "🔴 High",
    RanFromSuspiciousPath or (HasExternalNetwork and SpawnedChildren), "🟠 Medium",
    "🟡 Low"
)
| project

    Severity,
    DeviceName,
    ServiceProcess,
    ServiceProcessUser,
    ServiceProcessFolderPath,
    ServiceProcessCmdline,
    RanFromSuspiciousPath,
    HasExternalNetwork,
    ConnectedAddresses,
    ConnectedUrls,
    ChildProcesses,
    ChildCommandlines,
    FilesModified,
    FileModFolderPath,
    DLLsLoaded,
    ServiceProcessSHA1
| sort by Severity asc, FirstSeen desc

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
// === MalwareBazaar - recent SHA256 hashes ===
let MalwareHashes = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://bazaar.abuse.ch/export/txt/sha256/recent/"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator !startswith "#"
    | where string_size(Indicator) == 64 and Indicator matches regex @"^[A-Fa-f0-9]+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
// === 1. Match malicious attachment hashes ===
let MaliciousAttachments =
EmailAttachmentInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(SHA256)
| join hint.strategy=broadcast kind=inner (MalwareHashes) on $left.SHA256 == $right.Indicator
| project AttachTime = TimeGenerated, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          FileName, FileType, SHA256, NetworkMessageId;
// === 2. Enrich with delivery outcome from EmailEvents ===
MaliciousAttachments
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | project NetworkMessageId, EmailTime = TimeGenerated,
              Subject, EmailDirection,
              DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation,
              ThreatTypes, Recipient = RecipientEmailAddress
) on NetworkMessageId
| where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(Recipient) has TargetUser
// --- Classify exposure level ---
| extend ExposureLevel = case(
    DeliveryLocation in ("Inbox/folder", "Inbox"), "🔴 DELIVERED TO INBOX",
    DeliveryAction == "Delivered", "🔴 DELIVERED",
    DeliveryLocation == "Junk", "🟡 Junked",
    DeliveryAction in ("Blocked", "Replaced"), "🟢 Blocked",
    DeliveryLocation == "Quarantine", "🟢 Quarantined",
    "⚪ Unknown"
)
// --- Risk Score based on exposure ---
| extend RiskScore = case(
    ExposureLevel == "🔴 DELIVERED TO INBOX", 10,
    ExposureLevel == "🔴 DELIVERED", 9,
    ExposureLevel == "🟡 Junked", 5,
    2
)
// --- Check if the recipient CLICKED a URL (highest risk) ---
| join kind=leftouter (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | project NetworkMessageId, ClickTime = TimeGenerated,
              ClickedUrl = Url, ClickAction = ActionType
) on NetworkMessageId
| extend WasClicked = isnotempty(ClickTime)
| extend RiskScore = iff(WasClicked, RiskScore + 3, RiskScore)
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskScore >= 10, "🔴 Critical",
    RiskScore >= 7,  "🟠 High",
    RiskScore >= 4,  "🟡 Medium",
    "🟢 Low"
)
// --- Deduplicate ---
| summarize
    FirstSeen    = min(AttachTime),
    LastSeen     = max(AttachTime),
    WasClicked   = max(WasClicked)
    by Severity, RiskScore, ExposureLevel,
       SenderFromAddress, Recipient, Subject,
       FileName, FileType, SHA256,
       DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation
| project
    FirstSeen,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    ExposureLevel,
    WasClicked,
    Recipient,
    SenderFromAddress,
    Subject,
    FileName,
    FileType,
    DeliveryAction,
    DeliveryLocation,
    SHA256
| sort by RiskScore desc, FirstSeen desc

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
let SpamWindow = 10m;
let MinFailedAttempts = 5;
// === Feed 1: Feodo Tracker - Botnet C2 IPs ===
let Feodo_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://feodotracker.abuse.ch/downloads/ipblocklist.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
// === Feed 2: Tor Exit Nodes ===
let Tor_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://check.torproject.org/torbulkexitlist"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
// === Feed 3: Blocklist.de - Attacking IPs ===
let Blocklist_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://lists.blocklist.de/lists/all.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
// === Sentinel TI (kept from before) ===
let TI_IPs = ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true and isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | distinct NetworkIP;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserPrincipalName) has TargetUser
| extend
    DeviceDetail    = todynamic(DeviceDetail),
    LocationDetails = todynamic(LocationDetails)
| extend
    OS      = tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem),
    Browser = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser),
    City    = tostring(LocationDetails.city),
    Region  = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"
| mv-expand todynamic(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend AuthResult = tostring(parse_json(AuthenticationDetails).authenticationStepResultDetail)
// --- Aggregate per user + IP ---
| summarize
    FailedAttempts = countif(AuthResult has_any (
        "MFA denied; user declined the authentication",
        "MFA denied; user did not respond to mobile app notification",
        "MFA denied; duplicate authentication attempt",
        "user declined"
    )),
    SuccessfulAttempts = countif(AuthResult == "MFA successfully completed"),
    TotalPrompts   = count(),
    InvolvedOS     = make_set(OS, 5),
    InvolvedBrowser = make_set(Browser, 5),
    Cities         = make_set(City, 5),
    Regions        = make_set(Region, 5),
    Apps           = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
    StartTime      = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime        = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| extend AuthenticationWindow = (EndTime - StartTime)
// --- Flag bombing ---
| where FailedAttempts >= MinFailedAttempts
    and AuthenticationWindow <= SpamWindow
// --- CRITICAL: did the user cave? ---
| extend UserCaved = SuccessfulAttempts > 0
// --- Enrich source IP against all feeds ---
| extend
    IsFeodoC2   = IPAddress in (Feodo_IPs),
    IsTorExit   = IPAddress in (Tor_IPs),
    IsBlocklist = IPAddress in (Blocklist_IPs),
    IsSentinelTI = IPAddress in (TI_IPs)
| extend IsMaliciousIP = IsFeodoC2 or IsTorExit or IsBlocklist or IsSentinelTI
| extend FeedMatches = strcat(
    iff(IsFeodoC2, "Feodo-C2 ", ""),
    iff(IsTorExit, "Tor-Exit ", ""),
    iff(IsBlocklist, "Blocklist.de ", ""),
    iff(IsSentinelTI, "Sentinel-TI ", "")
)
// --- Risk Score ---
| extend RiskScore = 5
                   + iff(UserCaved, 4, 0)
                   + iff(IsFeodoC2, 4, 0)          // C2 infra = strongest
                   + iff(IsTorExit, 3, 0)          // anonymized = very suspicious
                   + iff(IsBlocklist, 2, 0)        // attacking IP = supporting
                   + iff(FailedAttempts > 20, 2, 0)
                   + iff(array_length(Regions) > 1, 1, 0)
| extend Severity = case(
    UserCaved and IsMaliciousIP, "🔴 Critical - Likely Compromised",
    UserCaved,                    "🔴 Critical - User Approved",
    IsFeodoC2 or IsTorExit,       "🔴 Critical - Malicious Source",
    FailedAttempts > 20,          "🟠 High - Heavy Bombing",
    "🟡 Medium - MFA Spam"
)
| extend Name = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, '@')[0]),
         UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, '@')[1])
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Severity,
    RiskScore,
    UserPrincipalName,
    UserCaved,
    IsMaliciousIP,
    FeedMatches,
    FailedAttempts,
    SuccessfulAttempts,
    TotalPrompts,
    AuthenticationWindow,
    IPAddress,
    Regions,
    Cities,
    Apps,
    InvolvedOS,
    InvolvedBrowser
| sort by RiskScore desc, UserCaved desc, FailedAttempts desc

content.query:
let TargetUser = tolower(trim(" ", "{UserPrincipalName}"));
// === Sentinel Threat Intel IPs ===
let TI_IPs = ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | distinct NetworkIP;
// === abuse.ch Feodo Tracker - Botnet C2 IPs ===
let Feodo_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://feodotracker.abuse.ch/downloads/ipblocklist.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
// === blocklist.de - Known attacking IPs ===
let Blocklist_IPs = materialize(
    externaldata(Indicator:string)
    [@"https://lists.blocklist.de/lists/all.txt"]
    with (format="txt")
    | where Indicator matches regex @"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$"
    | distinct Indicator
);
// === Combine all malicious IPs ===
let MaliciousIPs = materialize(
    union
        (TI_IPs | project MalIP = NetworkIP, FeedSource = "Sentinel TI"),
        (Feodo_IPs | project MalIP = Indicator, FeedSource = "Feodo C2"),
        (Blocklist_IPs | project MalIP = Indicator, FeedSource = "Blocklist.de")
    | summarize FeedSource = make_set(FeedSource) by MalIP
);
// === Correlate against successful sign-ins ===
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(UserPrincipalName) has TargetUser
| where ResultType == "0"                        // successful sign-ins only
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress,
          AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed,
          Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
          City = tostring(LocationDetails.city),
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus, UserAgent
| join kind=inner (MaliciousIPs) on $left.IPAddress == $right.MalIP
| extend Severity = case(
    RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium"), "🔴 Critical",
    ConditionalAccessStatus == "success", "🟠 High",
    "🟠 High"
)
| summarize
    FirstSeen     = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen      = max(TimeGenerated),
    SignInCount   = count(),
    Apps          = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
    Countries     = make_set(Country, 5),
    FeedSources   = take_any(FeedSource)
    by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Severity, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    Severity,
    UserPrincipalName,
    MaliciousIP = IPAddress,
    FeedSources,
    SignInCount,
    Apps,
    Countries,
    RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| sort by Severity asc, LastSeen desc

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let LLMDomains = dynamic([
    "api.anthropic.com", "api.openai.com", "openai.azure.com",
    "generativelanguage.googleapis.com", "aiplatform.googleapis.com",
    "api.mistral.ai", "api.groq.com", "openrouter.ai", "api.together.xyz",
    "api.deepseek.com", "api.x.ai", "api.cohere.com", "api.cohere.ai",
    "api.perplexity.ai", "bedrock-runtime",
    "dashscope.aliyuncs.com", "dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com", "api.moonshot.cn", "api.moonshot.ai",
    "api.kimi.com", "open.bigmodel.cn", "api.z.ai", "api.siliconflow.cn", "api.siliconflow.com",
    "api.minimax.io", "api.minimaxi.com", "ark.cn-beijing.volces.com", "api.stepfun.com",
    "qianfan.baidubce.com", "api.novita.ai"]);
let SanctionedProcs = dynamic([
    "msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe", "brave.exe", "msedgewebview2.exe",
    "claude.exe", "chatgpt.exe", "code.exe", "ms-teams.exe", "teams.exe"]);
let Tools = dynamic([
    "httpx", "subfinder", "katana", "ffuf", "nuclei", "naabu", "amass",
    "gobuster", "dnsx", "httprobe", "nmap", "masscan", "sqlmap"]);
let LLM = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "ConnectionRequest")   // Linux logs outbound as ConnectionRequest
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (LLMDomains) or ipv4_is_in_range(RemoteIP, "160.79.104.0/23")
    | extend IsSanctioned = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SanctionedProcs);
let ToolRuns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName in~ (Tools)
        or (FileName startswith "python" and ProcessCommandLine has "sqlmap");
let SensitivePaths = @"(?i)(/\.env|/\.git(/|$)|/\.aws/|/\.ssh/|/\.svn/|/\.hg/|/\.ds_store|/\.htpasswd|/\.htaccess|/\.npmrc|/\.dockercfg|/\.docker/|/\.vscode/|/\.idea/|/\.kube/|wp-config\.php|/config\.(php|json|ya?ml|ini)|/web\.config|/appsettings(\.\w+)?\.json|/phpinfo|/server-status|/actuator|/docker-compose\.ya?ml|id_rsa|\.(sql|bak|old|backup|swp|tar|tgz|zip)$|/backup)";
union isfuzzy=true
    (LLM | summarize Value = tolong(count()) | extend Metric = "🤖 LLM API Calls", Order = 1),
    (LLM | summarize Value = tolong(dcount(DeviceName)) | extend Metric = "💻 Devices Using LLMs", Order = 2),
    (LLM | where not(IsSanctioned) | summarize Value = tolong(dcount(InitiatingProcessFileName)) | extend Metric = "⚠️ Unsanctioned Callers", Order = 3),
    (ToolRuns | summarize Value = tolong(count()) | extend Metric = "🔎 Offensive Tool Runs", Order = 4),
    (LLM | where not(IsSanctioned) | distinct DeviceId
        | join kind=inner (ToolRuns | distinct DeviceId) on DeviceId
        | summarize Value = tolong(count()) | extend Metric = "🚨 Agent Hosts", Order = 5),
    (W3CIISLog
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where isempty(TargetDevice) or Computer has TargetDevice
        | where csUriStem matches regex SensitivePaths
        | where scStatus startswith "2"
        | summarize Value = tolong(count()) | extend Metric = "🔓 Sensitive Files Served", Order = 6)
| sort by Order asc
| project Metric, Value

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let BurstWindow = 5m;
let MinPorts = 10;
let MinTargets = 5;
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);   // approved scanner IPs, e.g. "10.0.0.50"
union
    (DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort, Outcome = "Accepted"),
    (DeviceEvents
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where ActionType == "FirewallInboundConnectionBlocked"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort, Outcome = "Blocked")
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where isnotempty(RemoteIP) and RemoteIP !in (Allowlist)
| where RemoteIP !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
| summarize Connections = count(),
            Ports = dcount(LocalPort),
            Targets = dcount(DeviceName),
            Blocked = countif(Outcome == "Blocked"),
            SamplePorts = make_set(LocalPort, 15),
            Devices = make_set(DeviceName, 10)
         by RemoteIP, Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| where Ports >= MinPorts or Targets >= MinTargets or Connections >= 200
| summarize Bursts = count(),
            MaxPorts = max(Ports),
            MaxTargets = max(Targets),
            Connections = sum(Connections),
            Blocked = sum(Blocked),
            SamplePorts = make_set(SamplePorts, 20),
            Devices = make_set(Devices, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Bucket),
            LastSeen = max(Bucket)
         by RemoteIP
| extend Source = iff(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP), "🏠 Internal", "🌍 External")
| extend Pattern = case(
    MaxTargets >= MinTargets and MaxPorts >= MinPorts, "🎯 Sweep + Port Scan",
    MaxTargets >= MinTargets, "🌐 Host Sweep",
    MaxPorts >= MinPorts, "🔎 Port Scan",
    "⚡ High Volume")
| extend SevRank = case(
    MaxPorts >= 50 or MaxTargets >= 20, 1,
    MaxPorts >= MinPorts and MaxTargets >= MinTargets, 2,
    Source == "🏠 Internal", 2,
    3)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| sort by SevRank asc, Connections desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, Pattern, Source, RemoteIP, Bursts, MaxPorts, MaxTargets,
          Connections, Blocked, SamplePorts, Devices, LastSeen
content.title: 🌐 Inbound Scan & Sweep Bursts

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let BurstWindow = 5m;
let MinFailures = 20;
let MinAccounts = 5;
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);
let Successes = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | summarize LastSuccess = max(TimeGenerated),
                SuccessAccounts = make_set(AccountName, 5)
             by RemoteIP;
DeviceLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed" and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| where RemoteIP !in (Allowlist) and RemoteIP !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
| summarize Failures = count(),
            Accounts = dcount(AccountName),
            SampleAccounts = make_set(AccountName, 10),
            Devices = make_set(DeviceName, 10),
            LogonTypes = make_set(LogonType, 5)
         by RemoteIP, Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| where Failures >= MinFailures or Accounts >= MinAccounts
| summarize Bursts = count(),
            Failures = sum(Failures),
            MaxAccounts = max(Accounts),
            SampleAccounts = make_set(SampleAccounts, 15),
            Devices = make_set(Devices, 10),
            LogonTypes = make_set(LogonTypes, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Bucket),
            LastSeen = max(Bucket)
         by RemoteIP
| join kind=leftouter Successes on RemoteIP
| extend Succeeded = isnotempty(LastSuccess) and LastSuccess >= FirstSeen
| extend Pattern = iff(MaxAccounts >= MinAccounts, "🧪 Password Spray", "🔨 Brute Force")
| extend Source = iff(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP), "🏠 Internal", "🌍 External")
| extend SevRank = case(Succeeded, 1, Failures >= 100 or MaxAccounts >= 20, 2, 3)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| extend SuccessAccounts = iff(Succeeded, SuccessAccounts, dynamic([]))
| sort by SevRank asc, Failures desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, Pattern, Source, RemoteIP, Succeeded, SuccessAccounts,
          Failures, MaxAccounts, SampleAccounts, Devices, LogonTypes, Bursts, LastSeen

content.query:
let BurstWindow = 5m;
let MinMatches = 50;
let MinRules = 5;
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Category == "ApplicationGatewayFirewallLog"
| where isnotempty(clientIp_s) and clientIp_s !in (Allowlist)
| summarize Matches = count(),
            Rules = dcount(ruleId_s),
            Blocked = countif(action_s == "Blocked"),
            SampleRules = make_set(strcat(ruleId_s, " ", Message), 10),
            SampleUris = make_set(requestUri_s, 10),
            Hosts = make_set(hostname_s, 5)
         by clientIp_s, Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| where Matches >= MinMatches or Rules >= MinRules
| summarize Bursts = count(),
            Matches = sum(Matches),
            MaxRules = max(Rules),
            Blocked = sum(Blocked),
            SampleRules = make_set(SampleRules, 15),
            SampleUris = make_set(SampleUris, 15),
            Hosts = make_set(Hosts, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Bucket),
            LastSeen = max(Bucket)
         by SourceIP = clientIp_s
| extend SevRank = case(MaxRules >= 15, 1, MaxRules >= MinRules, 2, 3)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| extend Pattern = iff(MaxRules >= MinRules, "🧨 Automated Probing", "⚡ High Volume")
| sort by SevRank asc, Matches desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, Pattern, SourceIP, Matches, MaxRules, Blocked,
          SampleRules, SampleUris, Hosts, Bursts, LastSeen

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let MinDistinct = 8;
let DiscoveryBins = dynamic([
    // Windows
    "whoami.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe", "nltest.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "systeminfo.exe",
    "hostname.exe", "tasklist.exe", "quser.exe", "qwinsta.exe", "query.exe", "arp.exe",
    "route.exe", "netstat.exe", "nslookup.exe", "dsquery.exe", "klist.exe", "gpresult.exe",
    "cmdkey.exe", "getmac.exe", "driverquery.exe", "wmic.exe",
    // Linux
    "whoami", "id", "uname", "hostname", "hostnamectl", "ifconfig", "ip", "netstat", "ss",
    "ps", "w", "who", "last", "groups", "env", "printenv", "lsb_release", "arp", "route"]);
let ScriptParents = dynamic([
    "python", "python3", "python.exe", "pythonw.exe", "node", "node.exe", "go",
    "powershell.exe", "pwsh", "pwsh.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe",
    "w3wp.exe", "sqlservr.exe", "java", "java.exe", "php", "php-cgi", "httpd", "nginx", "apache2"]);
let ExcludedParents = dynamic([
    "MsSense.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "SenseCncProxy.exe", "SenseNdr.exe", "MsMpEng.exe",
    "WaAppAgent.exe", "WindowsAzureGuestAgent.exe", "CollectGuestLogs.exe",
    "IntuneManagementExtension.exe", "AgentExecutor.exe", "CcmExec.exe",
    "mdatp", "wdavdaemon", "waagent", "omsagent", "azuremonitoragent", "telegraf"]);
let Discovery = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | where FileName in~ (DiscoveryBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (ExcludedParents)
    | extend Cmd = trim_end(@"\.exe", tolower(FileName))
    | extend Cmd = iff(Cmd == "net1", "net", Cmd)
    | extend Action = iff(Cmd == "net",
        strcat("net ", tolower(extract(@"(?i)net1?(\.exe)?\s+(\w+)", 2, ProcessCommandLine))),
        Cmd)
    | extend ParentKey = strcat(DeviceId, "|", InitiatingProcessId, "|", tostring(InitiatingProcessCreationTime))
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Account = AccountName, Action, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentKey, Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              GrandParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
union
    (Discovery | extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)),
    (Discovery | extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated + 30s, 1m))
| summarize DistinctCmds = dcount(Action),
            Actions = make_set(Action, 30),
            Execs = count(),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 15),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
         by ParentKey, DeviceName, Account, Parent, ParentCmd, GrandParent, Bucket
| where DistinctCmds >= MinDistinct
| summarize arg_max(DistinctCmds, *) by ParentKey
| extend SpanSec = datetime_diff("second", LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| extend IsScriptParent = Parent in~ (ScriptParents) or GrandParent in~ (ScriptParents)
| extend SevRank = case(
    DistinctCmds >= 15 or (DistinctCmds >= 10 and IsScriptParent), 1,
    DistinctCmds >= 10 or IsScriptParent, 2,
    3)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| extend Signal = "⚡ Machine-Speed Discovery"
| sort by SevRank asc, DistinctCmds desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, Signal, DistinctCmds, Execs, SpanSec, DeviceName, Account,
          Parent, GrandParent, Actions, ParentCmd, SampleCmds, LastSeen
content.title: ⚡ Machine-Speed Discovery

content.query:
let BurstWindow = 5m;
let MinFailures = 20;
let MinUsers = 5;
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);   // corporate egress IPs, VPN gateways
let FailCodes = dynamic(["50126", "50053", "50034", "50055", "50056", "50057", "50064"]);
let ValidPwCodes = dynamic(["50072", "50074", "50076", "50079", "50158", "53003"]);
let Signins = union
    (SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType = tostring(ResultType),
                  AppDisplayName, UserAgent, ASN = tostring(AutonomousSystemNumber), Location = tostring(Location)),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType = tostring(ResultType),
                  AppDisplayName, UserAgent, ASN = tostring(AutonomousSystemNumber), Location = tostring(Location))
    | extend UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | where isnotempty(IPAddress) and IPAddress !in (Allowlist);
let Successes = Signins
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | summarize LastSuccess = max(TimeGenerated),
                SuccessUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 5)
             by IPAddress;
Signins
| where ResultType in (FailCodes) or ResultType in (ValidPwCodes)
| summarize Failures = countif(ResultType in (FailCodes)),
            ValidPw = countif(ResultType in (ValidPwCodes)),
            Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
            SampleUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
            ValidPwUsers = make_set_if(UserPrincipalName, ResultType in (ValidPwCodes), 10),
            Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
            UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 5),
            Location = take_any(Location),
            ASN = take_any(ASN)
         by IPAddress, Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| where Failures >= MinFailures or Users >= MinUsers
| summarize Bursts = count(),
            Failures = sum(Failures),
            ValidPw = sum(ValidPw),
            MaxUsers = max(Users),
            SampleUsers = make_set(SampleUsers, 15),
            ValidPwUsers = make_set(ValidPwUsers, 10),
            Apps = make_set(Apps, 5),
            UserAgents = make_set(UserAgents, 5),
            Location = take_any(Location),
            ASN = take_any(ASN),
            FirstSeen = min(Bucket),
            LastSeen = max(Bucket)
         by IPAddress
| join kind=leftouter Successes on IPAddress
| extend Succeeded = isnotempty(LastSuccess) and LastSuccess >= FirstSeen
| extend SuccessUsers = iff(Succeeded, SuccessUsers, dynamic([]))
| extend Pattern = iff(MaxUsers >= MinUsers, "🧪 Password Spray", "🔨 Brute Force")
| extend SevRank = case(Succeeded, 1, ValidPw > 0, 2, Failures >= 100 or MaxUsers >= 20, 2, 3)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| sort by SevRank asc, Failures desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, Pattern, IPAddress, Location, ASN, Succeeded, SuccessUsers,
          ValidPwUsers, Failures, MaxUsers, SampleUsers, Apps, UserAgents, Bursts, LastSeen

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let MinPaths = 10;          // distinct sensitive paths for a machine-speed sweep
let SweepMinutes = 10;
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);   // approved vulnerability scanners
let SensitivePaths = @"(?i)(/\.env|/\.git(/|$)|/\.aws/|/\.ssh/|/\.svn/|/\.hg/|/\.ds_store|/\.htpasswd|/\.htaccess|/\.npmrc|/\.dockercfg|/\.docker/|/\.vscode/|/\.idea/|/\.kube/|wp-config\.php|/config\.(php|json|ya?ml|ini)|/web\.config|/appsettings(\.\w+)?\.json|/phpinfo|/server-status|/actuator|/docker-compose\.ya?ml|id_rsa|\.(sql|bak|old|backup|swp|tar|tgz|zip)$|/backup)";
W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or Computer has TargetDevice
| where isnotempty(cIP) and cIP !in (Allowlist)
| where csUriStem matches regex SensitivePaths
| extend Status = tostring(scStatus)
| extend Category = case(
    csUriStem matches regex @"(?i)/\.(env|aws|ssh|npmrc|docker|dockercfg|kube)|id_rsa|\.htpasswd", "🔑 Secrets",
    csUriStem matches regex @"(?i)/\.(git|svn|hg)", "🧬 Source Control",
    csUriStem matches regex @"(?i)\.(sql|bak|old|backup|swp|tar|tgz|zip)$|/backup", "💾 Backups",
    csUriStem matches regex @"(?i)phpinfo|server-status|actuator", "🩺 Debug/Admin",
    "⚙️ Config")
| summarize Requests = count(),
            DistinctPaths = dcount(csUriStem),
            Served = countif(Status startswith "2"),

            SampleUAs = make_set(UA, 10),
            SampleURLs = make_set_if(AttackUrl, isnotempty(AttackUrl), 10)
         by Site, Window
| where AttackSources >= MinSources and MedianPerSource <= MaxPerSource
| extend SevRank = iff(AttackSources >= 2 * MinSources, 2, 3)
| extend Severity = iff(SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| sort by SevRank asc, AttackSources desc
| project Window, Severity, Site, AttackSources, Sources, AttackRequests, Requests, MedianPerSource, UserAgents, SampleUAs, SampleURLs
content.title: 🌀 Rotating Proxy Probing

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);   // vulnerability scanners, monitoring, CDN and load balancer IPs
let Attack = @"(?i)(union(\s|\+|%20)+select|sleep\(|extractvalue|\.\./|%2e%2e|/etc/passwd|<script|%3cscript|\$\{|\{\{|/\.git|/\.env|/\.aws/|wp-config|phpinfo|web\.config|appsettings|\.(bak|sql|old|zip)$)";
let Probers = union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | project TimeGenerated, Prober = cIP, Url = strcat(csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery), Status = tostring(scStatus)),
    (AzureDiagnostics
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where Category == "ApplicationGatewayAccessLog"
        | project TimeGenerated, Prober = clientIP_s, Url = requestUri_s, Status = tostring(httpStatus_d))
    | where isnotempty(Prober) and not(coalesce(ipv4_is_private(Prober), false)) and Prober !in (Allowlist)
    | summarize ProbeRequests = count(), AttackRequests = countif(Url matches regex Attack),
                Errors = countif(Status startswith "4"), FirstProbe = min(TimeGenerated)
             by Prober
    | where AttackRequests > 0 or Errors >= 50;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "ConnectionRequest", "ConnectionAttempt")   // Linux logs outbound as ConnectionRequest
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| join kind=inner Probers on $left.RemoteIP == $right.Prober
| where TimeGenerated >= FirstProbe
| summarize Connections = count(),
            Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
            PentagiPortHits = countif(RemotePort between (28000 .. 29999)),
            Processes = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            Commands = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 5),
            FirstCallback = min(TimeGenerated)
         by DeviceName, RemoteIP, ProbeRequests, AttackRequests, FirstProbe
| extend MinutesToCallback = datetime_diff("minute", FirstCallback, FirstProbe)
| extend SevRank = iff(PentagiPortHits > 0, 1, 2)
| extend Severity = iff(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", "🟠 High")
| extend Signal = iff(SevRank == 1, "🎯 PentAGI Listener Port", "🔁 Callback to Prober")
| sort by SevRank asc, FirstCallback desc
| project FirstCallback, Severity, Signal, DeviceName, RemoteIP, MinutesToCallback, Connections, Ports, Processes, Commands,
          ProbeRequests, AttackRequests, FirstProbe
content.title: 🔁 Callbacks to Probing Addresses

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let Allowlist = dynamic([]);   // management, backup, monitoring and vulnerability-scanner hosts
let MinAccounts = 25;
let MinHosts = 10;
let Kerberos = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventID in (4768, 4771)
    | extend Src = trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress), Code = tostring(Status)
    | where isnotempty(Src) and Src !in ("-", "::1", "127.0.0.1") and Src !in (Allowlist)
    | summarize Events = count(), Targets = dcount(TargetUserName),
                UnknownUsers = countif(EventID == 4768 and Code =~ "0x6"),
                BadPasswords = countif(EventID == 4771 and Code =~ "0x18"),
                Sample = make_set(TargetUserName, 15), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated)
             by Src, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where Targets >= MinAccounts and (UnknownUsers >= 10 or BadPasswords >= 10)
    | extend Signal = iff(BadPasswords > UnknownUsers, "🔑 Kerberos Spray", "👥 Kerberos User Enumeration");
let FanOut = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3 and AuthenticationPackageName in ("NTLM", "Kerberos")
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or Computer has TargetDevice
    | extend Src = trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress)
    | where isnotempty(Src) and Src !in ("-", "::1", "127.0.0.1") and Src !in (Allowlist)
    | summarize Events = count(), Targets = dcount(Computer), Sample = make_set(Computer, 15), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated)
             by Src, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where Targets >= MinHosts
    | extend Signal = "🕸️ Logon Fan-Out";
let Hits = union Kerberos, FanOut;
let Both = Hits
    | summarize Kinds = dcount(iff(Signal has "Kerberos", "kerberos", "fanout")) by Src
    | where Kinds == 2
    | project Src;
Hits
| extend SevRank = iff(Src in (Both), 1, 2)
| extend Severity = iff(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", "🟠 High")
| sort by SevRank asc, FirstSeen desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, Signal, SourceIP = Src, Events, Targets, Sample
content.title: 🎫 Kerberos Enumeration & Logon Fan-Out

content.query:
let TargetDevice = trim(" ", "{DeviceName}");
let AttackTools = dynamic(["nmap", "naabu", "masscan", "nuclei", "katana", "dalfox", "ffuf", "gobuster", "feroxbuster",
    "dirsearch", "nikto", "sqlmap", "wpscan", "hydra", "medusa", "kerbrute", "netexec", "nxc", "crackmapexec",
    "bloodyad", "coercer", "enum4linux-ng", "chisel", "pwncat", "pwncat-cs", "evil-winrm", "responder",
    "cloudfox", "msfconsole", "searchsploit", "hashcat"]);
let AgentBinaries = dynamic(["claude", "codex", "qwen", "kimi", "opencode", "hermes"]);
let AgentCmdLine = @'(?i)(@anthropic-ai[/\\]claude-code|@qwen-code[/\\]|@openai[/\\]codex|kimi[-_]cli|opencode-ai|(^"?|[/\\])(claude|codex|qwen|kimi|opencode)(\.exe|\.cmd|\.js)?"?(\s|$))';
let AutoApprove = @"(--dangerously-skip-permissions|--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox|\s--yolo\b|\s--auto-approve\b|--approval-mode[\s=]+yolo)";
let Tools = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isempty(TargetDevice) or DeviceName has TargetDevice
    | extend Tool = replace_string(tolower(FileName), ".exe", "")
    | where Tool in (AttackTools) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("impacket-", "ysoserial", "jwt_tool");
let ByTree = Tools
    | extend Via = case(
        InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "shell-snapshots" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_LAUNCHER_SCRIPT", "Claude Code shell",
        replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), ".exe", "") in (AgentBinaries), strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " (parent)"),
        replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), ".exe", "") in (AgentBinaries), strcat(InitiatingProcessParentFileName, " (grandparent)"),
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Via)
    | extend AgentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Agents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex AgentCmdLine
    | project DeviceId, AgentPid = ProcessId, AgentTime = TimeGenerated, AgentCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let ByAgentProcess = Tools
    | join kind=inner Agents on DeviceId
    | where TimeGenerated between (AgentTime .. (AgentTime + 7d))
    | where InitiatingProcessParentId == AgentPid or InitiatingProcessId == AgentPid
    | extend Via = "Agent command line";
union ByTree, ByAgentProcess
| summarize Tools = make_set(FileName, 20),
            Commands = make_set(substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 200), 15),
            Via = make_set(Via, 5),
            AgentCmds = make_set(substring(AgentCmd, 0, 300), 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
         by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend AutoApproveFlag = tostring(AgentCmds) matches regex AutoApprove
| extend SevRank = case(AutoApproveFlag, 1, array_length(Tools) >= 3, 2, 3)
| extend Severity = case(SevRank == 1, "🔴 Critical", SevRank == 2, "🟠 High", "🟡 Medium")
| sort by SevRank asc, LastSeen desc
| project FirstSeen, Severity, DeviceName, AccountName, AutoApproveFlag, Via, Tools, Commands, AgentCmds, LastSeen
content.title: 🧠 AI Agent CLI Running Attack Tools

content.query:

| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsBillable == true
| make-series MB = sum(Quantity) default = 0 on TimeGenerated from startofday(ago(30d)) to startofday(now()) step 1d by DataType
| extend (Flags, Score, Baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(MB, 2.5, -1, "linefit")

content.query:
let Expected = datatable(Table:string, MaxMinutes:long) [
    "SigninLogs", 60, "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", 60, "AuditLogs", 120, "OfficeActivity", 120,
    "SecurityEvent", 60, "DeviceProcessEvents", 30, "DeviceNetworkEvents", 30, "DeviceEvents", 60,
    "EmailEvents", 120, "CommonSecurityLog", 30, "Syslog", 60, "AzureActivity", 240, "SecurityAlert", 1440, "Heartbeat", 15];
let Seen = union withsource = Table isfuzzy = true
        SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, AuditLogs, OfficeActivity, SecurityEvent,
        DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceEvents, EmailEvents, CommonSecurityLog, Syslog,
        AzureActivity, SecurityAlert, Heartbeat
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), LastIngested = max(ingestion_time()) by Table;
Expected
| join kind=leftouter Seen on Table
| extend MinutesSince = iff(isnull(LastIngested), long(null), datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastIngested))
| extend Status = case(isnull(LastIngested), "⚫ No data (2d)",
                       MinutesSince > MaxMinutes * 4, "🔴 Stopped",
                       MinutesSince > MaxMinutes, "🟡 Late",
                       "🟢 OK")
| extend SevRank = case(Status startswith "⚫", 1, Status startswith "🔴", 2, Status startswith "🟡", 3, 4)
| sort by SevRank asc, MinutesSince desc
| project Table, Status, MinutesSince, MaxMinutes, LastIngested, LastEvent

content.query:
SentinelHealth
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SentinelResourceType == "Data connector"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, Reason, Description),
            Failures = countif(Status == "Failure"),
            LastSuccess = maxif(TimeGenerated, Status == "Success")
         by SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceKind
| extend Health = case(Status == "Success", "🟢 Healthy", Status == "Failure", "🔴 Failing", strcat("🟡 ", Status))
| extend SevRank = case(Health startswith "🔴", 1, Health startswith "🟡", 2, 3)
| sort by SevRank asc, Failures desc
| project Connector = SentinelResourceName, Kind = SentinelResourceKind, Health, Failures, LastSuccess,
          LastEvent = TimeGenerated, Reason, Description

content.query:
union withsource = Table isfuzzy = true
    SigninLogs, AuditLogs, OfficeActivity, SecurityEvent, DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents,
    EmailEvents, CommonSecurityLog, Syslog, SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| extend LatencyMin = datetime_diff("second", ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) / 60.0
| summarize AvgMin = round(avg(LatencyMin), 1),
            P95Min = round(percentile(LatencyMin, 95), 1),
            MaxMin = round(max(LatencyMin), 1),
            Events = count()
         by Table
| extend Status = case(P95Min > 30, "🔴 Slow", P95Min > 10, "🟡 Lagging", "🟢 OK")
| sort by P95Min desc
| project Table, Status, AvgMin, P95Min, MaxMin, Events

content.query:

| where SentinelResourceType in ("Analytics Rule", "Automation rule")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, Reason, Description),
            Runs = count(),
